name: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
short: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions is a gamified focus tool, set to a soothing lofi soundtrack. Discover and collect Spirits, customize your cozy virtual space, and facilitate your real-life tasks with a collection of handy features designed to improve concentration and ease stress.
about: Spirit City: Lofi Sessions  is a gamified focus tool, set to a soothing lofi soundtrack.    With regular updates   — Expect new features and content throughout 2026!   Discover and collect Spirits, customize your cozy virtual space, and facilitate your real-life tasks with a collection of handy features designed to improve concentration and ease stress.          CHILL LOFI BEATS AND SOUNDS  Soft, soothing lofi music and dynamic soundscapes such as pattering rain and crackling fire provide the perfect background ambiance to relieve stress and unwind. All music in game is fully stream-friendly, perfect for featuring on Youtube or Twitch as a pleasing background.     Homework Radio music will be available until August 2028 (license period)                 SHOW OFF YOUR STYLE  Customize both your character and your bedroom to suit your mood, selecting from a multitude of fashion, hairstyle, color, and room decor options. From hoodies to horns, bookshelves to boba teas, fairy lights to fireplaces, there’s dozens of options available for you to flex your unique personality and style.             ADORABLE SPIRIT COMPANIONS  Explore different combinations of room activities, soundscapes, and decor options to lure out the mischievous Spirits that populate the world. Discover and collect them as you focus on your tasks. You'll never be alone with a Spirit companion by your side. And yes, every Spirit can be petted too!            BEGIN YOUR PRODUCTIVITY JOURNEY  Utilize built-in productivity tools, including a to-do list for organization, a  timer for focused work sessions, and a habit tracker and journal to foster a healthy routine. Earn XP for practicing good habits, unlocking more goodies over time - from new character & room cosmetics, to hints to help discover more Spirits, being productive has never been so rewarding!    KEY FEATURES    Listen along to a carefully curated catalog of chill lofi beats, with a selection of themed playlists for every mood and occasion;    Stay organized using integrated productivity tools, including a to-do list, session timer, habit tracker and journal;     Create your own avatar. Choose from a variety of hairstyles, outfits, color options, and more to bring to life your own unique Spirit City persona;    Spruce up your room to design your ideal cozy retreat, swapping between different wallpapers, flooring, furniture and wall decor;    Immerse yourself with interactive soundscapes that change the world in real-time to suit your preferred vibe, from the pitter-patter of rain on a window to the crackling of a toasty fireplace;    Decipher hints to lure curious spirits out into the open with the right combination of game settings, unlocking them as your future companions;    Earn XP and level up over time, and by using the game’s features to their fullest. Unlock new cosmetics and customization choices as you progress;    Stream your sessions worry-free thanks to the game’s fully stream-friendly music library - perfect for co-working streams or as a background on Twitch or Youtube;    Expand your song catalog with the built-in web player, providing even more options for the musically adventurous;    Enhance your everyday activities. Spirit City: Lofi Sessions offers a pleasing and distraction-free space for you to better enjoy and concentrate on your work and hobbies.

name: Idle Abyss Princesses
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
short: A desktop idle loot RPG with eight heroines and 24 talent paths. Mix legendary gear, sets, oddities and mythic items into your own build while battles run automatically, then take it into Legendary Rifts, an ultra raid and Abyssal Vows, where you choose your own curses.
about: Idle Abyss Princesses is a desktop idle loot RPG. Pick a heroine, choose her gear and skills, and let her fight. Come back later to check the drops, swap a piece of equipment, and see how much further she can go.   Play in a full window or switch to a transparent, always-on-top desktop widget. Open it up when you want to work on a build; leave it in a corner while you do something else.  Eight heroines with different ways to fight   Choose a Warrior, Mage, Paladin, Hunter, Machinist, Dragon Princess, Necromancer or Cultivator. Each has her own resource mechanics, skills, three talent paths and class equipment. Fight alongside a falcon or skeletons, set up turrets, call down lightning with a sword, or turn into a dragon.   Each heroine has six skills, with up to three equipped at once, plus runes and talents to change how they work. Gear can reshape the build too, including builds that fight bosses with basic attacks instead of skills. Heroines appear as chibi sprites in battle; the classic pixel sprites are one setting away.  Collect gear, then work out what fits   Fill twelve equipment slots from 219 legendaries, 27 sets, 20 oddities and Ancient or Primal pieces, and every rare item has its own hand-drawn pixel icon. Refine them through enhancement, enchanting, gems and extracted Cube powers. Oddities offer unusual benefits with drawbacks of their own.   When progress slows, stay at your current stage and farm, then adjust your skills, resistances or recovery. Test damage on training dummies and check which effects are actually active.  An endgame you can push alone   The campaign spans ten regions, followed by Nightmare, Hell and Torment difficulties, timed rifts, weekly rules and three expeditions.   Past floor 100, rifts become Legendary Rifts, where 51 Divine Beasts from Chinese, Japanese and American myth guard account-unique Mythic gear and titles.   In the post-finale ultra raid “This Is the Last”, you play your current heroine while three of your other characters fight beside her as shadow teammates.   Abyssal Vows lets you stack up to 25 vows on top of Legendary Rift difficulty. The harsher the vows, the higher your Rating and the more Blightheart you earn. Spend it to Etch your best gear even further, but a failed Etch Corrupts the item for good.   The Everlasting Night Court raid can be played solo on every difficulty, or with 2–4 friends.  Get to know the party   Main-story chapters, personal stories, manga and camp conversations reveal the heroines' pasts and the history of the abyss. Shared account storage and some shared progression make useful drops worth keeping for another character.   Battles continue while minimized, but there are no battle rewards while the game is closed or the computer is asleep; camp dispatches run on real time. Single-player content can be played offline; co-op needs an internet connection. Supports Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese and Korean. The macOS version supports Apple Silicon.

about: In  Tiny Birdtopia , your PC desktop isn’t just your workspace—but your very own bird sanctuary! Whether you’re in a meeting, drafting a report, or browsing the web, you can effortlessly manage your feathered paradise. Collect and nurture birds, unlock hidden species, and customize your birdtopia to your heart’s content—turn every work break into a chorus of birdsong!                   Every bird boasts its own unique plumage—gather their feathers to unlock secret, rare species! Explore the in-game  Birddex  to learn about each bird’s habits, habitats, and even listen to their distinctive calls. Whether you’re looking for a moment of calm or you’re a dedicated bird enthusiast, Tiny Birdtopia is the perfect pick-me-up between tasks!                        As a relaxing idle game, your birds will grow over time while you focus on your work—just sit back and watch them thrive!

name: Feather Land
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
short: Feather Land is a cozy idle focus companion where your study and work sessions help a peaceful bird world grow. Hatch eggs, care for cute birds, unlock new biomes, decorate your scenes, and stay focused with productivity tools, calming music, and nature sounds.
about: Hatch eggs, discover different bird species, and care for your growing flock. Feed them, pet them, and watch them wander through your screen as they slowly bring more life and movement to your space. From common birds to rare and extinct species, each companion adds its own charm.                 Feather Land includes simple tools to help you manage your time without pulling you out of the mood. Use the built-in Pomodoro timer, organize your tasks with a to-do list, and write down quick thoughts in the notebook. Soft birdsong, ambient nature sounds, and calming music create a soothing space for concentration, while your focus time helps you earn in-game coins, turning productivity into a relaxing way to grow your world.                  Expand your Feather Land by unlocking new lands, each with its own atmosphere, scenery, and bird species. Build cozy habitats across forests, mountains, deserts, beaches, and more. Every biome gives you a new cozy space to decorate, customize, and fill with birds.                  Make the space feel like yours. Add decorations, choose your favorite birds, adjust the weather, and change the time of day – from a sunny morning to a rainy afternoon or a quiet night. Whether you want a soft study corner or a tiny bird paradise, you can shape the atmosphere around your own rhythm.                 With Wallpaper Mode, Feather Land can stay on your screen as a gentle background companion while you study, work, or relax. Your birds continue to live quietly beside you, giving your desk a little more warmth without demanding your attention.

name: MISHA
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian
short: Misha is a cute anime girl who’s always by your side to brighten your day. She loves dancing, making funny faces, and trying on new outfits. Help her build a collection of stylish clothes!
about: Collect cute outfits, build Misha’s wardrobe and trade what you do not need!  Misha is a cheerful anime girl who is always on your desktop to brighten your day. She loves dancing, pulling funny faces and showing off new looks.  Misha is crazy about cosplay - from looks inspired by iconic game and pop culture characters to just plain beautiful everyday outfits. Your job is to help her unlock, mix and complete her growing collection of costumes.  Every tap earns points that you can exchange for clothes. Work, play or simply type - every action slowly pushes you toward a new outfit. Hunt for rare pieces and trade duplicates with other players through the Steam Community Market. Create the most stylish look for your new friend - Misha! 💛          Click, type, play — earn points   Click the mouse, press keys on your keyboard or controller — the counter grows with every action.          Exchange points for outfits   When the timer expires, a box appears. Click it and trade your accumulated points — receive a random outfit for your collection. To see how much time is left until the exchange, click the pedestal. The timer also appears in place of the points counter after a few seconds of inactivity.          Dress Misha   Open the interface, choose an item, and click — Misha instantly tries on the new look.          Trade duplicates or sell   Trade duplicates for rarer items or sell them on the  Steam Community Market  (in the release version). Go to the exchange tab. Click the auto-fill button or choose yourself which items to trade. Confirm the trade and receive an item one rarity tier higher!

name: Campfire Harmony
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Ukrainian
short: A little fox camps on your desktop and works while you work. Your keys and clicks keep it fetching firewood and roasting marshmallows for Stars, and every Star grows your camp. Take a break and it naps. Pet the fox, skip stones, and invite two friends to the fire.
about: A little fox has set up camp on your desktop to keep you company.  The fire crackles, soft lofi plays, and little by little, your busy days turn into a cozy camp of your own.           It works while you work   Every key and click, in any app, gives your fox energy. It fetches firewood, feeds the fire and roasts marshmallows, and every marshmallow turns into Stars. Now and then, one comes out golden. Stop for a while and your fox curls up for a nap until you're back.           Every Star grows your camp   Your camp starts small: a campfire, a tent, an oak and a fox. Spend Stars to upgrade them: marshmallows roast faster, logs burn longer, and each item changes its look as it grows. Finish one, and something new unlocks. No spoilers, but one of the trees is made of marshmallows, and your fox doesn't have to stay a fox.           Pet the fox. Skip stones.   Your fox watches your cursor go by. Rest your cursor on it for a pet, and it answers with a happy hop and a little heart. Down at the pond, flick a stone across the water and try to beat your best. At six skips, your fox cheers.           Invite company to your fire   Every key and click also adds a drop of ink to your ink well. Save some up and send a postcard: a traveler walks in, sits by your fire, helps with the firewood and leaves a gift of Stars. Or invite two friends from Steam, or visit theirs. short: A tiny, cozy idle fishing desktop companion about quiet progress, handcrafted islands, and stories hidden beneath the waves. Discover new species, upgrade your gear, customize your gears and let your fisher work peacefully in the background.
about: "Kernelbay is a    tiny,    cozy idle fishing desktop companion for quiet little moments."         More than a simple idle game, Kernelbay is a tiny cozy  desktop companion  built around a relaxing yet layered progression system. Follow your fisher from a humble dock to a chain of mysterious islands scattered across calm, fantastical seas. As the fishing loop unfolds, you’ll  unlock  new licenses,  upgrade  your gear,  customize  your boat, and  uncover  small surprises along the way.              There is  no rush .  No pressure . Only the sea and the quiet rhythm of progression.  Each island holds its own story, told through the unique creatures that inhabit its waters. As you unlock new licenses and discover new species, you reveal the hidden life of every island, one catch at a time.       The journey begins from a small dock. The fisher sets sail, casts the rod, and catches fish  automatically  while you go about your day. When storage is full or the boat reaches its travel limit, the fisher returns to port to unload the catch and prepare for the next fishing session.               With each return, you invest in better boats, stronger fishing rods, expanded storage, and improved range to explore farther waters. The loop continues, always present but  never intrusive .       What starts as a simple fishing loop slowly evolves. Unlock fishing licenses to discover new species. Explore handcrafted islands, each presented as a miniature diorama floating in the ocean. Every new island brings unique fish, resources, and progression layers that keep the journey fresh and rewarding.                   Kernelbay lives quietly on  your desktop . Each island features its own  wallpaper , which can  automatically  change as you progress, blending the world of the game into your workspace.  A  curated soundtrack  of 12 tracks (2 per island) evolves with your journey, creating a calm and cohesive atmosphere.  Lightweight and optimized, Kernelbay uses  minimal resources , letting you work, browse, or relax while it runs seamlessly in the background.

Observe Its Daily Habits  Your gecko will not always move on your schedule. It may rest, roam, find a place to hide, approach water, or respond when the timing is right. A Real Little Environment on Your Desktop  Heat lamps, water bowls, hides, and substrate all affect the temperature inside the vivarium. lang: Japanese, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Indonesian, Ukrainian, Dutch, Greek, Swedish, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Czech, Danish, Turkish, Norwegian, Hungarian, Finnish, Bulgarian, Vietnamese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Polish, Malay, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
short: A slacker stick figure named Bota moves onto your desktop. An idle app where you sneak peeks between tasks as he idly mutters to himself to match the time of day and the day of the week. He won't get in your way. Sometimes he talks to you. That's the whole app.
about: A Slacker Moves Onto Your Desktop!?  Sill Sticks is an idle desktop app where a stick figure comes to live on the edges of your desktop windows — all you do is watch and enjoy.  The star is "Bota," a stick figure who's sloppy, forever slacking off, a bit of a handful, and... maybe a little cute? Somehow, you just can't hold it against him. He grumbles and lazes around, yet he seems quietly happy somehow. Bota dreams of being a cat, is hopeless around sweets, holes up at every opportunity, and spends his days on games, TV, and sleep. You sneak a peek at his mutterings between tasks. That's the whole app.      Features     Mutters in context  — Bota idly talks to himself based on the time of day, the day of the week, and how long the app has been left running. In the morning it's "Still sleepy...", and late at night it's "Go to bed already... yeah, me too." The combinations produce different lines from day to day.     Just peek at him  — Bota knows you're there. Every now and then he'll talk to you. Maybe a friendship will blossom?     Stays out of your way  — Bota won't get in your way. He's just idling through life at his own pace. Though he does talk to you sometimes. Sometimes.    What's Next  We plan to keep updating Sill Sticks little by little.    Streaming Policy  Anyone is free to stream this game or post videos of it, monetized or not. No prior permission or notice is required.  You don't have to tell us, but we'd be truly delighted if you did. A quick note via Discord or X (formerly Twitter) would be much appreciated. You can find our Discord and X accounts on the store page. We'd also love it if you included the store page URL in your stream or video description. And if we know in advance, we may be able to help promote your stream.  That said, please refrain from streams that fall under the following.  - Streams involving anything illegal - Streams that offend public order and morals - Streams that promote violence or discrimination - Streams based on specific political or religious advocacy - Any other streams that common sense would deem inappropriate  Even if a stream does not fall under the above, we may ask for it to be stopped or removed, for any reason, if we judge it inappropriate.  As long as you're streaming for fun, there's no problem at all. We're looking forward to your streams!

name: Desktop Ball
lang: English*, French*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Korean*, Polish*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese*, Spanish - Latin America*, Croatian*, Turkish**
short: A little ball that lives on top of your desktop and can blow it up, zap it, flood it, haunt it, or grow a garden all over it. Fidget with it through meetings, queues and compiles, and when you're done, it gets out of the way. Seven weird balls, and every one of them beats doomscrolling.
about: It lives on your desktop.  It's a little toy that lives on top of your desktop, sort of like a digital fidget spinner.  Play with it in a queue, a meeting, a compile, a render, whenever your hands want something to do. Grab it, fling it around, bounce it off the edges of your monitors, and when you stop playing, it gets out of the way so everything else just works underneath.  Had a rough day?  Yeah... these two are for you. Pin the Supernova against an edge until it gets  DANGEROUSLY HOT , and it goes off in a  violent thermonuclear explosion  that sets your screen on fire.   Tesla is a thunderstorm squeezed into a ball. Charge it against an edge, throw it hard, and  THUNDER STRIKES . Even your mouse gets charged up and starts zapping things.             Touch grass. Then haunt it!  Sprout turns your desktop into a cozy little garden. Roll it along the edges to grow flowers, or  squeeze it to grow vines all over your screen . Just remember to  trim it  once in a while.  Ghost, on the other hand, HAUNTS your desktop.  Every throw leaves a little ghost behind , and if you squish it into a wall they just keep coming. They spook easily and they  definitely  don't pay rent.            Splash or dunk?  Spongeball turns your screen into a tiny ocean, with a little school of fish to bother.  Let the sponge soak up water, then wring it out  against your monitor. Or just slosh it all around aggressively (the fish love it!)  The Basketball slides its own hoop out from the side of your screen. Bank shots, trick shots, and  dunks so good the ball catches fire , followed by a  completely unnecessary amount of confetti .            Pinky and the gang  Pinky is the mascot, and the squishiest of the bunch. He has no thoughts, only kinetic energy.  Squish him flat against a wall and he slingshots across your screen.  Super small chance he'll wink at ya.  Right-click any ball to swap it for another, each with its own little backstory. And the first time you open the game,  the whole gang shows up to dance for you  :)            Pick up and play    Always there for you when you want to grab it    Leave it alone and it keeps going: the fish keep swimming, butterflies visit your garden, and the ghosts drift around.    Hides itself if you go fullscreen, or you can tuck it in a Magnetic Corner    Seven balls so far: Pinky, Supernova, Tesla, Spongeball, Basketball, Sprout, and Ghost      I lost an embarrassing amount of that time just playing Desktop Ball, instead of making it... I hope it keeps you good company :)

name: My Desktop Cat
lang: English, French, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese
short: A cozy cat moves onto your Windows desktop and lives behind your windows, never in front of your apps. Feed and pet it, play mini-games, decorate its room, welcome kittens and grow together all the way to level 100. Free to play; optional extras are cosmetic.
about: My Desktop Cat brings a little cat to live right on your Windows desktop: it wanders, naps and plays behind your windows while you work, and your bond grows a little every day.    A cat on your real desktop    Your cat lives on the desktop itself, behind your windows, so it never covers your apps.    It wanders, naps in its bed, eats, grooms itself, stretches, gets the zoomies and follows your cursor, at its own daily rhythm.    A little thought bubble tells you when it is hungry, thirsty, sleepy or would love a cuddle.    If you allow it, your cat even comes to sniff new files that appear on your desktop.      Care for it every day    Click its bowls to fill them, pet it, and choose from six treats, each one aimed at one of its six needs.    Pick a toy and watch your cat chase it under your pointer.    Every day in the grooming room, follow six little paths with the brush, one per spot, and a little flower blooms for each one.    Set up a scratching post: your cat comes to sharpen its claws on its own, or as soon as you click it, which helps its hygiene.    Sow the variety you like in the cat grass planter, watch it grow, and your cat will come and nibble it.    Each cat has its own temperament, shaped by care and play, while your bond grows from Shy to Best friend.      A growing family    Adopt more cats: each keeps its own name, needs and level, and you choose who keeps you company.    In the nursery, pick a mum and a dad among your adopted cats and watch them meet gently, to the sound of a little music box.    The next day, a kitten waits in its basket: it takes after one of its parents, with a real cat coat inherited from their genes, tabby, tortoiseshell, bicolour, pointed, blue or lilac…    Its rarity, from common to legendary, is revealed at birth; before naming it, you can draw its genes again, once for free, then for 20 Kibbles.    It arrives tiny on your desktop and grows up in a week, and every week brings a new free meeting.      All the way to level 100    Your cat earns XP as you look after it and can climb all the way to level 100.    At every new level, three cards float above your cat on the desktop: pick one and it hops up to break it.    A card can hold Paw Coins, a lasting bonus on your Paw Coin rewards, a need that drops more slowly, double XP for 24 hours of play, a blue box, or a premium item.      Little daily rituals    Each day brings three goals, including a mini-game mission, along with your cat's own wish of the day.    The daily box is yours for free once a day, and every seventh one is golden.    Fill the weekly notebook with your days of care and granted wishes to earn another golden box.    Six cozy mini-games await in Missions, from Treat rain to the Radio concert, and each one pays Paw Coins for its first win of the day.    In Jungle Dash, your cat races to an old temple picking up kibble: jump over logs, slide under branches and switch lanes before the cheeky monkeys catch you.    If you are away for a week or more, your cat keeps a golden box for your return.      A cozy corner, your way    Turn your desktop into one of 23 illustrated rooms, each with a clear floor for little paws, or keep your own wallpaper.    Five optional animated decors bring a room to life: birds at the window, pumpkin lanterns for your cat to wake, a studio whose lights dance with the radio, leaves swept along by the wind, or a jungle treehouse where the sun gives way to the moon and fireflies.    Put your own pictures on your desktop in photo frames, in four styles, facing you or turned aside.    Place up to eight perches to build climbing routes, and set the bowls, bed and radio wherever you like.    Switch on the desktop radio to stream the included lo-fi station or control your own music player, and your cat comes over to listen.      Cats, treasures and collections    Meet eight cats: Maple Tabby from the start, Classic White and Mist Chartreux for Paw Coins, and five premium cats including Marigold, the gold

short: Turn your balcony into your very own birdwatching spot, and await the arrival of new avian friends! Enjoy a cozy idle game — place a tiny postcard on the corner of your screen, keeping you company with pleasant scenes and visiting birds. Oh, and don't forget your camera!
about: Birders, assemble!    We've developed a cozy idle game just for you. Now, you can enjoy birdwatching from the comfort of your desktop, too!     Place your postcard — a window to another world — right at the corner of your screen.    Decorate your favourite birding spot to your heart's content. If a bird happens to fancy your humble abode, it just might stop by for a visit!      Join us on Discord!       Unlock a variety of birding spots! The docks, beaches, deserts, even rainforests…  Each place has its own unique scenery, and new bird species to discover!  (The demo version is currently limited to the Balcony.)               Your Birding Area can be freely manipulated!   Zoom, move, and arrange your favourite birding spot however you like   — the birds will keep you company while you work.                The Blueprint System is now live!  You can save your builds, share them, and quickly switch between different designs!           Sparrows aren't the only birds that want to hang out. There are dozens of other bird species, too!   They have their own preferred times to visit — maybe you can capture something wonderful!  (The demo currently features around 20 bird species!)          The more a bird visits, the more comfortable they'll feel!   You might be able to discover new behaviors over time…         Snap! Immortalize your favourite moments with your camera.   Once you've documented every unique behavior from a bird, you'll earn a statue of them!               Any new lifers today?  Your handbook also keeps a record of Birding Areas, decoration, photographs, achievements, and more!          If you enlarge the main illustration, you'll be able to discover just what traits make that bird special!               You can change the time of day and weather of your Birding Area as you desire.   Regardless of time, or weather, you'll meet a new friend who enjoys it, that's for sure!          In the night, nocturnal birds await…             Your bird friends will bring all sorts of trinkets for you to collect!   They'll drop all sorts of colorful feathers, and maybe more…               Boss Crow loves anything that sparkles — whether it be shimmering feathers, or the bright glint of bottle caps!   He'll return the favor in Crow Coins!           More features are under development:     you'll be able to share gorgeous birding spots with your friends, and more…

about: Hamster Talk is an idle social game where adorable hamsters live and move right on your screen, keeping you company throughout your day.     🌿 An idle game that never gets in the way of your routine   It’s okay to step away or focus on something else. Your hamsters keep playing on their own, quietly going about their day on your screen.  Even while you’re studying or working, simply leaving Hamster Talk open lets your day with the hamsters continue naturally. They’re always there, right on your screen.             🐹 Spend time with adorable hamsters   Different hamsters wander across your screen, playing with various items.  Tap a hamster to see its adorable reactions instantly.          As you pet them, feed them, and clean their space, you’ll notice their happy moments and affectionate behaviors.  The more time you spend together, the more enjoyable it feels.     🧵 Popo Farm: Packed with the Fun of Farming and Producing   Place your hamsters on Popo Farm to see them move adorably while producing a variety of resources. name: Firewall Breaker
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish
short: Firewall Breaker settles into the corner of your screen and gets to work. While you're in a meeting, watching a video or on another tab, it hacks, attacks and grows stronger. You just check the results.
about: Runs in the corner. Works while you don't.  Firewall Breaker lives at the edge of your screen while you work, browse or watch something. No babysitting, no clicking, no aiming. It hacks, earns and grows stronger whether you're paying attention or not. Pick a window size from tiny up to 2000×2000, keep it always on top and get back to your day.  Deploy your payload. Let it run.  Fill your RAM with up to  13 unique hack types , each one a weapon with its own behavior. Start with the humble Ping Package, then bring in chain-lightning Worms, Keyloggers that mark targets for extra damage and Rootkits that keep burning long after the hit.                  Your payload fires on its own and tears through waves of Grid Cells, Defensewalls and the Firewall itself. Every 50 waves, a  Boss Firewall  stands in the way.          Build. Update. Rebuild. Repeat.     Data  is your in-run currency. Spend it on Data Updates to push every stat further.     Rebuild  wipes your run for  Crypto  and permanent multipliers to Data, XP and Crypto. Turn on Auto Rebuild and let it happen on its own.     Crypto Updates  carry over forever, including Overclock, a raw damage multiplier for the long haul.                    Go gold with Prestige weapons  Every weapon has a gold Prestige version that hits on a completely different scale while using the same RAM. Prestige upgrades are permanent and survive every Rebuild.          Collect hardware, complete sets  Equip from  50 passive hardware items  and complete  6 hardware sets  for extra bonuses. Shape your build around the drops you find.          Make it yours     8 visual themes  you can switch any time, with a live preview     Offline earnings  keep coming in while the game is closed, for up to 8 hours    Detailed statistics, 36 Steam achievements and 12 languages            The deeper you go, the harder the Firewall hits back. But so do you.

short: Your Wife is an anime desktop companion game. Choose a character whose gaze follows your cursor, adjust her position and size, and pair her with static or animated wallpapers. Subscribe to and share characters and wallpapers through Steam Workshop.
about: A familiar desktop, a welcome companion  Your Wife is an anime companion game for your Windows desktop. Find a spot for your favorite character, choose a background you love, and let her keep you company as you work, study or unwind. Move your mouse now and then, and catch her eye.  Choose who keeps you company today  Choose your favorite look from  8  built-in characters, or use characters you have subscribed to in the Workshop. Natural blinking, gentle breathing, and animated hair and clothing bring your desktop companion to life. Her gaze follows your mouse, too.  One character is displayed at a time. Switch whenever you like from the menu, and save a corner of your desktop for today's companion.  Her position and size are up to you  Drag your character to a comfortable spot, then use the mouse wheel to adjust her size from 55% to 450%. Keep her at the edge of your screen, or enlarge her to enjoy the details.  Mouse clicks pass through the character's transparent areas. To keep using the windows behind her, enable lock mode and let clicks pass through the entire character. Unlock her from the system tray when you want to interact again. You can also hide the character separately while keeping your wallpaper active.  Make your background part of the scenery  The built-in original Moonlit Violet Rose Terrace wallpaper combines moonlight, roses and violet hues to complement the character's silver hair and black-and-white dress. Choose the static version for a peaceful scene, or switch to the animated version to watch petals fall and twirl, fireflies drift, and moonlight gently shift.  You can also use local  GIF  or  MP4  files as animated wallpapers, or choose static and animated backgrounds from the Workshop to create your own character and desktop combinations.  MP4  wallpapers loop without sound.  Discover more combinations in the Workshop  Browse and subscribe to characters and wallpapers shared by other players, then manage and use your subscriptions in the game. You can also upload compatible character assets, static images or animated wallpapers to share your creations with others, and update or delete your own uploads.  Make it fit your routine    Your character choice, position and size are saved automatically, so your setup is ready the next time you launch the game.    Choose whether the character stays on top, the taskbar icon is shown, and the game starts with Windows.    Choose from  30  interface languages and switch at any time in settings.    Includes  100  Steam achievements, which you can start unlocking one by one from the menu.    A few things to know  This desktop companion is designed for the Windows desktop. To keep your character visible while playing other games, windowed or borderless fullscreen mode is recommended; exclusive fullscreen may cover her. Animated wallpaper playback compatibility depends on the file's encoding, your system's decoding support and your desktop environment.

name: Deadline Savior Demo
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Italian, Spanish - Latin America
short: This idle RPG adventure is based on the "Pomodoro Technique." Complete focused work sessions to advance your character's exploration. To reclaim the Goddess's Hourglass and restore peace, the hero must defeat the evil dragon "Procrastination" and its minions. The world’s fate is in your hands!
about: The Demo has been fully updated to Version 0.4!   Check out the new features below!    "Deadline Savior" is a game that combines a Pomodoro task manager with RPG elements.  By completing Pomodoro focus sessions, your hero will explore a fantasy world, defeat enemies, and gradually grow stronger.       According to an ancient prophecy, the hero will eventually defeat the evil dragon known as "Procrastination," reclaim the Goddess's Hourglass, and restore peace to the world.  -------- Demo save data can be carried over to the full version!  And if you've played the Demo, you'll receive a small gift in the full version! --------      The Demo includes the following features:              Generate a "Focus Style Assessment" based on your focus habits!    Use the task list to track the time spent on specific tasks.    Review your task completion progress over 1-day, 5-day, and 30-day periods, including charts showing your accumulated focus time and other statistics.    During Pomodoro focus sessions, your character will explore the game world and earn experience and money.    When a focus session ends and the break phase begins, your character will encounter various events, including battles. Completing these events will earn you various rewards.    While exploring, your character can obtain a variety of items, including equipment, battle items, adventure items, and more.    Your character can level up and learn battle skills.    Battles are fought automatically based on your equipped battle skills and items.    --------         Compared with the full version, the Demo has the following limitations:      Only Paladin and Ranger are available as playable classes. (More classes are available in the full version.)    Goddess Blessings, the game's persistent progression system, are limited to Level 5.    Due to this Blessing limit, only the two initial map sizes are available.    The Demo has a smaller pool of obtainable items and equipment. (The full version includes equipment for many more classes.)    --------            Thank you for trying the Demo! We'd greatly appreciate any feedback after you've played, so we can continue making the game even more fun!    See you in the full version!

name: Idle Defragmenter 95
lang: English**
short: Idle Defragmenter 95 is a relaxing idle desktop toy inspired by 90s defrag utilities. Run it as an overlay or window, watch sectors organize automatically, and unlock DOS / 95 / XP eras and upgrades while you work or play.
about: Idle Defragmenter 95   A relaxing idle  desktop toy  inspired by classic defrag utilities. Run it as an  overlay or window , watch chaos organize itself, and upgrade your retro setup through new visual eras.  How it plays    The “disk” reorganizes automatically (true idle).    You choose upgrades and unlock new looks/eras (DOS → 95 → XP).    Perfect to keep open while you do other things.    Why it’s satisfying    Visual “stimming”: watching everything fall into place.    Chill progression: no stress, constant progress.    Nostalgia: retro UI + optional sounds.    Features    Overlay mode + Window mode    Unlockable eras: MS-DOS, Windows 95, XP    Upgrades for speed, style, and nostalgia power    Optional retro / ASMR-ish audio    Made to accompany you while you work, study, or play    FAQ     Is this a real defragmenter?  No. It’s a game/simulation inspired by classic utilities.     Do I have to keep clicking?  No. It’s idle: it runs on its own; you choose upgrades.     Does overlay use a lot of resources?  It’s designed to be lightweight; usage depends on your settings and hardware.     Can I play without overlay?  Yes—window mode works normally.

name: Genesis Relic: Idle Sandbox Simulator
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
short: A diverse sandbox idle sim featuring multiple maps from Three Kingdoms to cultivation, cats to cosmos. Offers varied gameplay: survival, management, nation-building. Includes an in-game editor to customize worlds, characters, and stories. Create, share worlds with Workshop support.
about: "Create and share your own world"—this is a high-freedom idle simulation game featuring a built-in editor. The game offers a series of short-session, fun-themed maps with diverse gameplay! From traditional simulation management—recruiting workers and developing industries—to managing internal affairs, recruiting legendary characters as your right-hand helpers, and altering destiny. It also includes challenging survival gameplay where you gather resources, build shelters, and face world resets when health runs out. Plus trading, character cultivation, immortal cultivation (Xianxia), and more! Supports creating and sharing your own worlds, Steam Workshop integration, and taking on challenges from other players' worlds.                Idle casually, collect resources, upgrade and build, recruit workers and automate—you'll need to manage and balance the production and consumption of various resources while gradually unlocking more features. Every stat and resource is intricately interconnected. Plan your layout well, then let it run idle, and watch those numbers soar!                A feature-rich desktop text game! Perfect for multitasking—run it while you work or study. Position the window anywhere on your screen, resize freely, adjust transparency, and quickly hide it with the sidebar!                The built-in maps feature diverse themes, fast-paced action, and deep gameplay! Lead your empire in an epic Three Kingdoms saga—recruit workers, develop industries, enlist legendary heroes, and conquer the realm. Survive a brutal world where you explore, gather resources, and upgrade your base, but drop to zero health and it's game over. Or become a dimension-hopping merchant, trading across worlds to amass resources and upgrade your starship for epic voyages!   Countless other worlds and adventures await your discovery!                  In Creation Mode, you can build your very own world! Add various functional modules and resources, configure detailed functions and underlying interaction logic for each module to implement gameplay rules such as simulation management, survival, hero recruitment, gacha systems, and more. You can also create new characters with images and backstories, and add rich game storylines! Feature a visual relationship graph!                You can export and share your custom world with other players, or import maps created by others to play! It supports the Steam Workshop, allowing you to share and interact with players from around the world!     This is a sandbox simulator for idle games. We only design the underlying logic, and we have used this logic to create numerous built-in worlds. The style, story, and development of more worlds will all be defined by you!

name: 姑苏恋语 Demo
lang: Simplified Chinese*, English*
short: 《Suzhou Love words》is a distinctive visual novel that skillfully blends romance and comedy. Set in Suzhou, the game offers players a uniquely local love story inspired by the city’s culture, scenery, and atmosphere.
about: You are an art student studying in Suzhou, pushed forward by the mounting pressure of graduation and the search for a job.  Between quiet canals, classical gardens, and misty rain, you step into Sushu’s studio. In this gentle old city, you begin to uncover the feelings she hides behind her smile—and find the courage to keep moving forward.  Later, you return to your hometown to serve as a groomsman at a classmate’s wedding. There, you reunite with Lin Feier, an old classmate from your school days. Long-buried feelings and missed opportunities begin to resurface.  Faced with two very different girls, what kind of romance and choices await you?  This is a romance visual novel featuring two heroines, both available to pursue. Your story is waiting to begin.                   Susu             The owner of a studio in Suzhou, Susu is gentle and mature, carrying the calm elegance and quiet charm of a Jiangnan water town in everything she does.    She is always smiling as she takes care of the people around her, while quietly hiding her own disappointments and worries among rainy nights and glowing streetlights.    As you gradually grow closer to her, you may discover that beneath her seemingly effortless warmth lies a fragile heart longing to be understood.       Lin Feier             Your former classmate, whom you meet again after many years, has blossomed from the shy girl in your memories into a dazzling and captivating woman.    Intelligent and confident, with a hint of playful mischief and emotional distance, she always seems to know exactly how to make your heart skip a beat.    Yet beneath her brightness and teasing humor lie regrets from the past and feelings left unspoken, waiting to be brought into the light once more.       Ajuan             Susu’s assistant at the studio may look like a child, but she is, without a doubt, a true senpai. Despite her appearance, she is surprisingly capable and professional whenever she is working. Even after completing the game, you can continue spending time with your favorite characters as they accompany you while you work, study, or relax—bringing the romance beyond the story and into everyday life.             Visually, 《Suzhou Love words》 strives to deliver a high-quality presentation worthy of the best Chinese indie visual novels.  From the atmosphere of its environments and the performances of its characters to the unified style of its CG illustrations and animated portraits, every encounter, every flutter of the heart, and every emotional moment is supported by carefully crafted visuals.  The game’s art direction is based on the real streets and scenery of Suzhou. name: Vibralizer
lang: English
short: Music visualizer for Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal, SoundCloud, YouTube, Ableton, or a microphone — anything that plays sound! Hand-crafted Vibes that don't just react to the music; they show it in real-time. No AI-generated imagery. Built in Nashville by two people who love human-made music and art.
about: Vibralizer is a real-time music visualizer for any audio source. Play music on any platform - Spotify, SoundCloud, YouTube, Apple Music, Ableton, your own microphone, anything - and Vibralizer turns the sound into something worth looking at. Our hand-crafted Vibes don't just react to the music: they're built to  show  it. Like subtitles, but for sound. Using NO AI-generated imagery.  How To Use:  1) Start playing your music.  2) Click over to Vibralizer.   3) Choose a Vibe, then put it on in the background… or the foreground.          Features:    Hand-crafted Vibes. No generative AI imagery used in any of our art.    Native loopback support - no plugins or extra downloads required.    Full screen and windowed views.    Spout output; feel free to record and use on social media, on Twitch, during live events, or however else you like!    Now-playing track information display and controls for Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, and many other streaming platforms (Windows only)    Audio Representation, Not Just Reaction  Most visualizers react to audio by simply pulsing to the beat or volume. We wanted something different.   Our Vibes are built to  represent  what's happening in the music and to feel like subtitles for sound. Kate - one of our founders - has hearing loss, so this is how we actually think about sound visualization. We built Vibralizer to enhance the experience of music, whether you're hearing every frequency or none of them.  A Note On System Requirements  The requirements listed below are best guesses, since we haven't been able to test every configuration. Vibralizer may run fine on hardware below what we have under “minimum requirements.” If you're under it and want to try the demo, please do and let us know how it went!   Tag Us  If you make a video or stream with Vibralizer, tag  @vibralizer  on Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Bluesky, or Facebook. We love seeing what people do with it, and we'll re-share when we can!     Thanks for coming along on this journey! We’re excited to build and vibe with y’all.    - Kate and Nick

name: Dungeoneers Idle
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese
short: An endless idle RPG with no finish line. Build a party of heroes, craft the gear that makes them stronger, and let them fight and loot through procedural dungeons on their own, even in a little window on your desktop while you work. Or jump in and play any hero yourself.
about: Dungeoneers Idle is an endless idle RPG about building a party and letting it work, with the option to jump in and play any hero yourself.    Assemble a team from twelve hero classes, carve each hero's path through a huge passive tree, and send them into procedurally generated dungeons. Combat resolves itself. Your job is the decisions that matter: who goes, which skills they bring, what they wear and which piece of gear is worth crafting into something special. Early on you make those calls by hand. Later, you buy the automation that makes them for you.    It keeps going when you don't. Close the game, come back tomorrow, and your party will have spent the night clearing dungeons, levelling up and swapping in better gear.    It doesn't run out. Hero levels have no cap, the depths keep scaling as fast as your party does, and every prestige measures you against your own deepest run rather than a fixed target. This is an idler built for months, not for an evening.              Keep it on your desktop  Companion Mode folds the game into a small, see-through window you can place anywhere on your screen. Your party keeps fighting while you work, watch something or play another game, and a double-click brings the full game back.                Build a party, then let it work    Twelve hero classes: Warrior, Mage, Rogue, Cleric, Ranger, Pyromancer, Druid, Necromancer, Barbarian, Ninja, Electromancer and Bard. Five are yours from the start.    Hand-authored skills, unlocked and levelled with gold. Each hero carries only two (at first) into a dungeon, so a loadout is a real decision rather than a checklist.    A passive tree of over 1000 nodes for every hero. Save your favourite builds or export them as a code to share, and two heroes of the same class can still play nothing alike.    Start with room for two heroes and earn your way to four.         Dungeons that build themselves    Five dungeon types: Crypt, Cave, Fortress, Temple and Frost. Generated fresh every time, each with its own themed enemies.    An overworld of eight biomes to push outward through, from plains and forest to volcanic wastes.    Combat with status effects, elites, bosses and summoned minions.    Enemies, bosses and dungeon art made from scratch for this game, from scrappy goblin raiders to a Goblin King in a crown he definitely stole.      See it through their eyes    Hero View: watch any dungeon in first person, through the eyes of one of your heroes.    Take Over: grab the controls and play that hero yourself, with WASD and the mouse, while the rest of the party fights alongside you. Hand them back whenever you like.    Arrows and spells fly for real and light up the dark as they go. Knock the dead flying with ragdoll corpses.    Nine extra achievements and three trials just for steering a hero. All optional, so idle players miss nothing.                Gear worth chasing    Five rarities, Common through Legendary. Epic and Legendary pieces roll three or four stats, so no two drops look alike.    80 special effects that change how a hero fights, many made for a single class: crits that freeze enemies solid, a basic attack that strikes twice, enemies that explode when they die, an angel that pulls a hero back from death once per dungeon.    Effects roll their own strength, so there is always a better version out there.    Lock your favourites so nothing great ever gets sold by accident.      Make your best gear even better  Found something you love? Keep it. Crafting turns the gear you would have thrown away into the gear you never take off.    Salvage what you don't need into Shards.    Hone a single stat a little higher with every try.    Reforge an old favourite up to your current depth, so a great find stays great.    The toughest monsters leave rare trophies behind that give your best pieces an extra line.    Bank the best stats and effects from every Epic and Legendary you salvage, then imprint them onto the gear you actually wear.                Autom

short: One fortune slip a day. With a one-in-a-thousand chance, your day of great misfortune arrives. If there is something you keep putting off deciding — then make your decision when that day of great misfortune arrives.
about: One fortune slip a day  Every morning, she hands you a line.  It doesn't tell you what to do, urge you to work harder, or tell you how you "should be". Just a verse, a word, a warmth — so that before you sit down, you already know what kind of day today is.  Great blessing or minor blessing. After you read it, you still go and do what you were going to do. It just gives you a little more confidence inside.         The one-in-a-thousand day of great misfortune  On average, everyone gets one especially unlucky day every thousand days.  Not a disaster, not a tragedy — just the world suddenly falling silent for a beat. You keep to your usual pace, but today it just doesn't work out.  It's the same in the game. You draw one fortune a day, and the chance of great misfortune is one in a thousand. On the day you draw it, the cat girl puts on another face. She doesn't speak, and she doesn't comfort you. You look at her, and she looks at you.       If there is something you can't bring yourself to decide  Then wait.  Wait for a day of great misfortune.  This isn't superstition, and it isn't running away. It's just giving yourself a reason — "If today is already this unlucky, then doing this thing today probably can't turn out any worse."  Or maybe:  If the day of great misfortune never comes, maybe this thing wasn't something you needed to rush after all.       She won't push you  This isn't a game you need to "clear". She just curls up in the corner of your screen and sleeps quietly,  gives you a line every day, and occasionally hands you a little something.  She just stays there quietly, forever asleep.  Silently waiting for your day of great misfortune to arrive.   Fate gives no word; may the rest of your days be quiet and peaceful.        One-Sentence Description   A one-in-a-thousand great misfortune, with one-hundred-percent company.          Game Controls  Left mouse button: You can drag the cat girl to move around the screen;  Right mouse button: Click the cat girl to bring up today's fortune slip;  Left mouse button click on today's fortune slip: Brings up the fortune panel, where you can read the explanation of today's fortune;  Show or hide the cat girl: Alt+Q  Show or hide the fortune panel: Alt+H

When a friend enables care from visitors, you can help with food, water or litter. Your care takes effect when their home next comes online—a small kindness for later. Sometimes, it’s enough to watch them be cats.          Full-screen animated screensaver · return to desktop companionship when you leave   Switch to the full-screen animated screensaver and let their little home fill your screen. A quiet nap. A lazy afternoon. Pair your day with a focus timer, ambient sounds and reminders, and make a little room for rest as well as work. A home to check in on: food, water, litter and outfits, with baths, blow-drying and fishing to watch.  Greetings from a trip: messages, illustrated travel photos and treats brought home to share.  Steam friends' homes: browse synced homes and leave asynchronous care when the owner allows it.  Room for a break: a full-screen animated screensaver, focus timer, ambient sounds and alarms. Adjust the number and size of desktop cats and their behaviour to fit your routine. Resource use varies with the number of cats, scene, resolution and hardware. It started with two cats beside my computer.  I have two cats at home. While I work, they often lie beside my computer and quietly keep me company. I get on with my tasks; they get on with their naps. One glance away from the screen makes the desk feel a little warmer.  Those ordinary moments inspired A Cat of My Own. I wanted to bring that feeling to your desktop: cats nearby while you are busy, and a little window to open when you want a break, top up a bowl, or see how their day is going.  Making this game is a way of putting a little of my life with them into something I can share. I hope that, next time you sit down at your computer, you find a moment like that too. about: This system is a core feature of the product, enabling real-time interaction between the desktop pet and the user's keyboard and mouse operations, enhancing the sense of companionship and interactivity. It also includes a cumulative reward mechanism to increase user engagement.  Valid keyboard and mouse input is defined only as mouse clicks and keyboard keystrokes. Mouse movements and scroll wheel movements are not counted as valid input and do not trigger any feedback or statistics.  Action Feedback Cooldown Rule: When the user performs consecutive and rapid valid input, each click or keystroke triggers the corresponding action, without a minimum trigger interval or cooldown time.  Differentiated Feedback Rule: All valid keyboard and mouse input triggers the same set of universal actions; no differentiated feedback actions are set for different keys or operations.  This mechanism supports both real-time action feedback and cumulative click rewards, which can run in parallel without conflict.  Reward Trigger Conditions: Users who simultaneously meet two conditions within a single period—being online for 30 minutes and accumulating 1000 valid clicks—can unlock access to the treasure chest.  Treasure Chest Consumption Rules: Users need to accumulate 1000 clicks to open a treasure chest. The treasure chest reward pool includes two categories of items: outfits and emoticons.  Reset Rules: After a treasure chest is successfully opened, the current period's online time and accumulated valid clicks are immediately reset to zero, and timing and statistics restart.  This system is a core collection-based gameplay system, establishing the entire process of acquiring, synthesizing, wearing, and trading outfits. It serves as the core commercialization vehicle for the product while also satisfying users' personalized outfit needs.

about: Yokai Parade is a resident idle game that lives at the bottom of your screen while you do other things. Watch the parade Along the bottom edge of your desktop, yokai amble by. A lantern ghost, a little tofu carrier, a kappa... wondering who'll walk past next is most of the game, and the koban pile up while you wonder. Open up the board Spend your koban opening the board, one tile at a time. Depending on where you open, the takings grow, rarer yokai start dropping by, or the parade just gets livelier. The odd purple tile hides a shrine or a torii gate, and word is there are yokai you'll only ever meet by opening one. Fill the codex The parade brings familiar faces and the occasional "who is that?". The same yokai might show up as a woman, an elder, a child, or something a touch scarier on certain nights. Seal the regulars you've seen plenty of, and let the ones you haven't met take their place. Fill the codex to a milestone and the yokai may just throw a little celebration. Wait for the festival As the parade rolls on, the festival gauge slowly fills. When it does, the night market bursts into celebration: fireworks, festival music, koban coming in thick. Then it winds down, and the quiet parade returns. Strangely habit-forming, this loop. It stays out of your way The whole point of this game is not bothering you. When you start concentrating on something else, the yokai walk even more softly. Clear the background away and the parade strolls right on your wallpaper. Koban keep trickling in for a while even when the game is closed, so open it whenever it crosses your mind. Day, night, and the moon The view follows your PC's clock. Morning sky in the morning, night sky at night. The moon waxes and wanes day by day, and if you're up late on a full moon, you might meet a rather special one. Night owls get an always-night setting, too. Pixel art and music Everything on screen is pixel art, lit by the lanterns of a nostalgic night market. Whether you're crunching numbers at the office, finishing school assignments, or just unwinding after a busy day, your furry friend is always there to keep you company.   Backpack Cat makes itself at home in the background while you're busy, so no need for constant attention. Just check in from time to time, collect your rewards and give your kitty a bit of love. Remember, every click and keystroke helps your companion collect coins for special rewards and upgrades, turning computer time into game time. When you need a break from work, they're always ready to play.       Reward Everyday Tasks           The more active you are, the more coins your kitty earns. Collect coins, to unlock new items for your pet and its cozy backpack home.    Custom Kitty Looks and Backpack Decorations                Change your pet’s style, with cute outfits and colorful backpacks.Collect cool decorations and rare items to make your Backpack Cat one of a kind. Collect, Combine and Create Rare Items           Grow your collection as your kitty brings you valuable items. Combine several to create new and rarer accessories. Craft your way to unlock the best rewards.    Add Backpack Cat to your desktop and enjoy its company all day long!

name: DesktopDaily Demo
lang: Japanese*, Simplified Chinese*, English**
short: Ami Koharune and Tsukuyomi-chan live on your PC. Chat with voiced characters whose gestures match their words, or watch them cook, read and sleep in a shared home that doubles as a live wallpaper. Free demo with trial credits for chat.
about: DesktopDaily is a free 3D desktop character app. She stays in a corner of your desktop, out of the way while you use your PC. When you feel like talking, she replies in her own voice, with gestures to match. When you're busy, she has things of her own to do. Gestures that match every line Dialogue is generated by the language model you choose. Every reply is accompanied by hand gestures, nods, head tilts, gaze, forward or backward leans, and facial expressions, timed to the corresponding words: palms together when apologizing, counting on her fingers, or resting her hands by her cheek when saying goodnight.   Waving, heart signs, pinky promises, handshakes, thumbs-up, peace signs, covering her mouth as she giggles, flexing her arms... Over 40 hand gestures, made to fit the two characters' proportions.   Speech is synthesized locally on your PC using voice material publicly licensed by the characters' voice actors. Chinese, Japanese, English, and sentences mixing all three are supported.   She starts speaking as the audio is generated, without waiting for the entire passage to finish synthesizing.   Type your message, or turn on your microphone and speak to her directly.   A shared home, even when you're not chatting Click the house icon on the status bar above the character to visit the home Ami and Tsukuyomi-chan share. Each has her own bedroom, with a shared living room and kitchen.   They walk around, read, look out the window, cook, sit down to eat together, and go to bed at night. You don't have to assign them tasks.   The lighting, lamps and wall clock follow your PC's time. Morning, daytime and nighttime each have different background music.   Click a character to bring the camera closer. Pat her head, tug her cheeks, tap her nose, give her a high five or shake her hand. Call her over, say goodnight, wake her up, or offer her a bite while she's eating. If she's cooking or reading, she'll put down what she's holding before coming over.   The home can become a Windows live wallpaper. The desktop character, home and wallpaper can each go on a different monitor.   She remembers what you've talked about   Your conversations stay in her long-term memory, so she can pick up where you left off next time.   Let her sleep for a while. As she sleeps, she'll recall moments from your recent time together. The more you talk, the more she has to remember.   With Steam Cloud enabled, her memories come with you when you switch PCs.   Watch your game or work together (Visual Companion Beta) Share your entire screen or a single window. She watches along and speaks up when something worth mentioning changes. You can also ask her about what's on screen at any time.   Screen capture starts only when you turn the feature on. You can pause or stop it whenever you like.   Adjust how often she speaks. The session stops automatically after you've been away from your PC for a while.   Images are sent to the model service you select so it can understand what's on screen. When using the official trial, they pass through our servers.   Other little things on your desktop    Selfies:  She picks up a selfie stick to capture herself together with your desktop or game screen. Choose her expression and adjust the distance of the selfie stick.    Activities:  Let her choose something she'd like to do, such as going fishing.    Handy tools:  Counters, cumulative goals and countdowns. She'll say something when you're done.   Drag her wherever you like, or shrink her down. You can also adjust the UI size and background transparency.   Characters  Ami Koharune (CV: Amitaro)  She works at a café, loves cooking and enjoys trying out her own combinations. Bugs and thunder scare her. Easygoing and a little like an older sister, she gets shy when a compliment catches her off guard, and occasionally slips into a Kansai accent. name: Time Collage: Focus Puzzle
lang: English, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Danish, Ukrainian, Russian, Hungarian, Indonesian, Turkish, Czech, Polish, Thai, Swedish, Romanian, Dutch, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Spanish - Latin America, Vietnamese, Arabic, Norwegian, Finnish
short: An ADHD-friendly, low-distraction focus and productivity game built around instant feedback. When distraction or procrastination makes starting hard, this quiet desktop buddy keeps you company through Pomodoro study and work sessions, with to-dos, white noise and puzzle rewards.
about: Focus for just 3 minutes and earn a puzzle piece    A pretty good deal, right?     Time Collage is a game that supports your focus through  instant feedback .               01 Random puzzle drops keep you company through every focus session    Your focus space is split in two: Puzzles on the left, focus tools on the right   Start the focus timer on the right, and the puzzle area on the left comes to life.  Every few minutes of focus, a random puzzle piece drops.   Session by session, your time takes shape as a little scene of your own.           Tips:   ① Try the  To-do, Memo, Count and Mindfulness  tools, too.      You can  move and resize them freely  to create your own focus space.  ② Enable  Puzzle Piece Sorting and Quick Place  in Settings for an easier way to put the pieces together.             02 Finish the puzzle and watch the picture come to life   Each new journey begins with a randomly selected puzzle, based on the priorities you set.  When the last piece falls into place,  the still picture comes to life , becoming a postcard to remember this journey by.           Drop it into the mailbox to unlock your next journey.            Tips:   ①  Your focus records and puzzle progress are saved automatically.  No need to finish in one sitting: take each journey at your own pace.  ② A small selection of puzzles is included. Getting more requires an internet connection and a Steam sign-in.  The Demo includes only a small selection to try.      03 More to discover in the game   You can:     Revisit each journey      Unlock achievements and spend the rewards on Views      Choose your favorite music and white noise      Explore detailed focus statistics     …             04 Where the idea came from   The game was inspired by the developer’s own experience of living with ADHD:  “Getting started and staying focused have always been a struggle for me.”  “I’m not lazy. I just can’t stay focused — that’s my ADHD.”  “This Pomodoro app looks promising. Let’s give it a go! (Two days later: already forgotten…)”  “These apps can track every detail, but staying focused still comes down to willpower…”  “What if I kept getting  rewards as I focused … 🤔”  “What if there were always  something new to look forward to …”  …     And so, TimeCollage was born.   I wanted to make an ADHD-friendly productivity game: a low-distraction desktop companion for study and work. Whether you already use the Pomodoro technique or struggle with procrastination and difficulty getting started, a to-do list can help with task management, while a focus timer lets you begin with one small thing. Light-touch gamification turns time spent focusing into puzzle-piece rewards and achievements. Instant feedback and focus statistics make your effort visible, adding a little motivation to everyday productivity.  With minimal interaction needed during focus sessions, it can be a quiet background companion; come back for a little puzzling whenever you feel like a break. Among cozy picture-book scenes, soft ambient sounds and white noise, I hope this study buddy offers gentle, relaxing company — a space with no pressure and no rush, where you can keep going at your own pace.  I hope you can redefine focus here, and let every session leave a gentle trace.

name: Second Monitor Football
lang: English**
short: A lightweight, physics-based football auto-simulation designed to be played or watched on a second monitor just press play and let the match unfold.
about: Second Monitor Football is a lightweight, physics-driven football simulation designed to live on your second screen. Whether you're working, browsing, or playing something else, you can sit back and watch matches unfold with zero required input perfect for low attention gameplay. Or lean in, take control, and join your team on the pitch.    Built around simplicity and unpredictability, the game lets physics take the spotlight. Players move, collide, and interact with the ball in dynamic ways, creating chaotic, often hilarious moments. Goals aren't scripted they happen when the ball finds its way into the net through pure motion, momentum, and a bit of luck.     Play your way.  Watch hands free as the match plays itself out, or jump in and join the action: steer a player in the team and unleash power-ups freeze the opposition, knock out their keeper, shield your own goal to swing the game in your team's favour. Power-ups are earned through play, and the AI coaches will fire theirs right back at you.   Play together.  Team up with friends in multiplayer: join forces with up to 4 players on the same side through full competitions, or drop into casual matches with up to 8 players, 4 per team for an end to end showdown.     Stream it.  Twitch streamers can invite their viewers straight into competitions and casual matches, turning a quiet second-screen sim into a shared, chaotic spectacle.    Progress comes from the teams you follow and the competitions you choose to engage with. Whether you're committing to a full season or casually checking in on key matches, Second Monitor Football adapts to your pace. A core part of the experience is freedom. With built-in modding support, you can shape the game however you like custom leagues, custom teams, and your own football world.          You can play Second Monitor Football with your favorite streamer! Open the game login to Twitch. SMF only ask for a permisson from Twitch. Viewers start the game type your favorite Twitch channels name. Streamer starts an event or maybe a casual match. And meet at the pitch!     No Twitch account information is stored.  Only asks Authorization Token from Twitch.  Login from your default web browser.  Only using chat futures and followers to invite players to lobby.                Designed to run in a small window alongside your main activity. Watch matches without needing constant input.  Perfect for multitasking progress and enjoy the game while focusing on what matters most.  Just press play and let the simulation decide the outcome.           Unpredictable, dynamic gameplay where every goal is the result of real interactions no scripted outcomes.  Select a match and start immediately. No setup, no management screens just football.           Choose a team and follow the full season or drop in to watch only their matches.         Experience global competitions with the same hands-off, watch-and-enjoy approach.         Compete in knockout-style tournaments and see how far your chosen team can go.  Follow both club and international teams across larger stages and multi-tier competitions.         Create your own leagues, customize team names, and add logos to build a completely personalized football universe.

name: Taskbar Miracles: A Little Adventure
lang: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
short: An idle RPG that lives on your Windows taskbar. A tiny party travels, fights and loots on its own while you work. You're the little god they hear: your everyday typing becomes grace and lightning from above. Stop, and they carry on. Only key counts are used, never what you type.
about: Will is chopping wood outside his cabin when he hears it: a voice from somewhere above. It's your keyboard. "That's no wind... someone up there is talking." He shoulders his pack and sets off. From now on, you're the little god watching over his journey. A little adventure along your taskbar On a long, narrow road just above your Windows taskbar, your companions travel, fight and gather on their own, and run into the odd surprise: a lost chest, a giant gold mushroom, a wrong turn. After each leg they rest by the campfire, then set out again. You work, study or watch videos; they live their own days at the edge of your screen. The sky follows your PC's clock, so when you stay up late, they light torches and keep walking.         Your typing is the voice of a god No window switching, no special controls. Just type, anywhere:   The heart bar beside the Mark gathers  Grace . The fuller it is, the more gold and materials the party finds, and the faster they explore.   The purple sparkle bar lights up a little with every key. Once it's full,  lightning strikes by itself  mid-fight, hitting the enemies bunched closest together.   Typing during a fight helps your companions act faster.           Besides typing, you can drag a fighter along the lane mid-battle. After a short, one-time typing prologue, the party carries on when you stop. Typing makes the journey smoother; you can check in whenever you like. Companions who talk, and remember At first, they're not sure what to make of you: "That voice... that's a god, right?" "No idea. At least they haven't asked for money." The longer you travel together, the more they get used to you, and their chatter on the road and jokes by the fire change with it. When your lightning lands, whoever is nearby reacts on the spot. That night at camp, they might still be talking about it. Their chatter draws on the journey and events they've experienced. It stays brief and never needs a reply.         Grow a party worth checking on Whenever you feel like managing, click the bag to open the Travelling camp.   Team : every companion has an element and a fighting style of their own. One charges in and sweeps the crowd, one stacks damage by chain casting, one raises shields, one holds the front and heals the party, one plants a string of firecrackers to blow armour open, one leaves enemies weaker and slower. Pick three, then set the front, middle and back rows.        Gear : monsters and chests drop weapons and charms with rarities and affixes. Temper them with each region's ore, reforge the affixes you don't like, and salvage the rest into essence.             Making : gather materials and make new gear from recipes, including recipes for what mid-bosses drop.        Growth : level up with gold, unlock skills and ultimates as levels rise, break through level caps and choose talents.   Bosses : mid-bosses wait along the road. Fill the exploration bar to challenge the boss and move on to the next stage. Every boss has attacks and weak spots of their own, and a loss brings up a tip card.   Difficulty tiers and divine power : seek better gear in deeper tiers, earn divine power from bosses, and choose the miracles that your typing charges.      Made to fit around your work    Offline haul : closing the game doesn't waste the journey. Next time you open it, the adventure you missed is settled and laid out as a haul (normally up to 8 hours, increased to 12 after obtaining Moondew).    Boss key : Ctrl+Alt+Shift+H hides and mutes the game at once. Press it again to bring it back.    Out of the way in fullscreen : when you play a fullscreen game or video, the strip slides to the very edge of the screen, and you can choose to show only the party, or only the HUD.    Low maintenance : when the gold star lights up, one click levels up whichever companion is cheapest; hold it to keep going. Losing to a boss costs nothing, and being away never takes your gear.
