name: Monstarium
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
short: Tiny pixel monsters live along the bottom of your screen, and climb on top of your windows. Hatch eggs, merge twins to evolve them, and collect over 1,000 looks across 95 forms while you work. Pet them, toss them a treat, and watch them make friends.
about: A terrarium that lives on your desktop Monstarium sits along the bottom of your screen, on top of your other windows, and stays out of the way. Clicks go straight through to whatever is behind it. Only the monsters themselves catch your mouse. They don't stay put Monsters wander off the strip and climb on top of your open windows. Move a window and they tumble back down. Hatch, merge, evolve Buy an egg, wait a minute, meet someone new. Drag a monster onto its twin and the two become something bigger. There are 37 evolution lines, 95 forms and 5 biomes to open, with new species turning up every day of your first week.         Collect every look Each form comes in 4 colors and 6 rare variants: crystal, autumn, spotted, starry, rainbow and one that belongs to its biome. Rebirth a biome and its forms unlock a golden look too. That adds up to over 1,000 looks. A built-in guarantee means you are never stuck hunting the last one forever. They have a life of their own   Pet them, drop a treat and watch the race, or throw the ball around.   Monsters that play together become best friends.   Grant their little wishes and they earn stars of affection.   Open a monster's diary, give it a name, or take it for a walk on a leash.   Dress them up with 21 hats. Some you buy, some come with an achievement, and four only show up during seasonal events.   Send a team from the box on an expedition and see what they bring back.   Birthday hats, Christmas caps, real seasons, a rare golden visitor, hide and seek, and a few secrets.          Idle for real Nobody starves and nobody dies. Nothing piles up while you are busy. Leave it alone for a week and your monsters are still there, glad to see you. Seasons and friends Halloween, Christmas, Lunar New Year and Easter come back every year with their own decorations, a hat and egg colors you only find then. Miss one and nothing is lost: those looks are a bonus and never needed to finish anything. Invite a Steam friend and three of your monsters go visit their screen while three of theirs walk on yours. A companion for work and study Pick a favorite to live in the corner of your screen. Feed it, play with it, and it keeps you company: it reminds you to drink water, naps through your focus sessions and cheers when you finish. It never gets sick. It just misses you. If you like, hide the strip and keep only your companion.         Focus with them Set a focus timer from 15 to 90 minutes and keep a short to-do list next to it. Monstarium counts your focus minutes for the day and the week, and when you finish a task a monster cheers. Mix rain, fireplace, birds, stream, night and ocean sounds at whatever volume helps you work. Made for the background Monstarium earns coins while it is closed and goes to sleep when you step away. On our test PC it uses about 1% of the CPU, and a low-power mode cuts that further on laptops. It never reads your keyboard or what you type in other programs, and there is no store inside the game: buy it once and everything is yours. For streamers A green screen mode for OBS and an optional Twitch hookup. Viewers type !monster and a name in chat to name one of your monsters. Features   Always on top, with full click-through   A strip along the bottom or a column of floors on the side of the screen   Over 1,000 looks to collect, 21 hats and 73 achievements   Seasonal events every year and friend visits through Steam   Focus timer, to-do list and ambient sounds   Real daylight, seasons and optional real weather for your city   Low-power mode, adjustable opacity and a hotkey to move it to another monitor   10 languages: English, Portuguese, Spanish, German, French, Polish, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Japanese and Korean   Progress while the game is closed, cloud saves and daily backups   No account, no marketplace items, no battle pass, no tracking. Buy it once and it is yours

about: Sumi is a tiny pixel girl in a little glass device that sits in the corner of your screen while you work, play or wind down. She has her own day: she stretches in the morning, gets cozy in the evening, changes her clothes when she feels like it, and falls asleep when it gets late. Leave for a while and she'll miss you. Pick a few small daily goals (water, a stretch, lunch, a walk, a focus hour, bed on time). She reminds you at the right moment and celebrates with you when you're done. name: Pocket Studio Desktop Companion
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
short: Design a game. Pick its genre, its topic, who it's for. Then go do your actual work - every keystroke you type writes another line of it. A tiny developer builds, ships, and gets reviewed for your ideas, in a little window in the corner of your screen.
about: A tiny game developer has set up shop in the corner of your screen. They have ideas, ambition, an office chair, and no way to write a single line of code on their own.  That part is your job. Every key you press - in your editor, your inbox, a document you're already behind on - becomes a line of code in their current project. You do your work. They ship games.  Every game is one you designed  Before they start, you decide what they're making: a name, a genre, a topic, and the audience it's for. Cyberpunk Racing for Teens. Farming Horror. Ninja Cooking Sim, for Kids.  Nothing tells you whether it's a good idea. Some combinations click, some quietly fall apart, and a few disasters turn into cult hits. You find out at launch - with a review score, a payout, and a box on the shelf.  Bugs happen  Projects don't stay the size you agreed to. Bugs surface while they work, each one pushing the finish line a little further out, and there's exactly one way to deal with them: keep typing. Just like at your job.  The studio grows  Money from shipped games goes back into the studio, five ways:     Coding Speed  - squeeze more lines out of every keystroke.     Game Quality  - score better, sell more.     Scope Handling  - from a weekend prototype up to the MMO they keep talking about.     Clean Code  - fewer bugs in the first place.     Debugging  - and cheaper ones when they show up anyway.    Earnings also buy new rooms to work in, so the studio slowly stops looking like a first job.  Read the post-mortem  Every shipped game keeps its own breakdown: how well the genre suited the topic, whether you aimed at the right audience, how tired the idea had gotten, what the bugs actually cost, and what all of that did to the money. The rules are never explained up front - you learn them one release at a time.

name: Knead a Break Demo
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: From its cozy bed, Knead watches over a human who sits too much. When you sit too long, this grumpy cat pops up to cause mischief. But it's smart: it senses your flow and waits for a natural pause to nudge you. It isn’t being naughty—it just wants to get you out of your chair so you can move around.
about: WHAT'S IN THIS DEMO  In this demo, Knead keeps you company on your desktop, comes out to invite you when it is time for a break, and guides you through simple, desk-friendly movements. You can also care for it, watch it grow, leaf through your shared journal, and look forward to letters from its travels and mysterious gifts when it returns.  MEET KNEAD  Knead is a small Abyssinian with a permanently unimpressed face. It sprawls over a ball of yellow yarn in the corner of your Windows desktop, quietly watching over a human who spends a little too long at the computer.  Most of the time, it sleeps peacefully. But when it is time for a little movement, it knows exactly how to make itself noticed.  A LITTLE MISCHIEF, FOR A REASON  Knead is not another quiet notification.  It peeks over the edge of your window, or clings on and gives the window a tiny shake.  It steals a little attention on purpose—just enough to break through your focus and lure you away from your work for a moment. Each interruption is brief, playful, and unmistakably feline.  A FEW MINUTES, THEN BACK TO WORK  Interacting with Knead opens a compact guided-movement window. It demonstrates one simple, desk-friendly movement at a time, accompanied by a short instruction and timer.  A little stretch, a little movement, and a short break becomes a moment together. Afterwards, you can return to whatever you were doing.  A LITTLE MOVEMENT, A LITTLE GROWTH  Usually, Knead is the one looking out for you. You can look after it too, with a little food in its bowl and some fresh water beside it.  The moments you spend moving and caring for it help it grow, and find their way into your shared journal. Every now and then, you can turn back a few pages and see how much time you have spent together.  COME THE WEEKEND, IT HAS PLANS OF ITS OWN  On weekends and holidays, you can plan a little journey for Knead on its hand-drawn map. While you take some time away from work, it gets to see the world beyond your desktop.  A journey usually lasts a full weekend or holiday break. It will generally send a letter on the first day, letting you know how life on the road is treating it.  When it comes home, there will be mysterious gifts tucked away in its bag. What they are can wait until you are together again.  NOT NOW? A LITTLE LATER  When the timing is not right, Knead can wait a little longer. It goes back to rest for a while before coming to find you again.  The cat may be persistent, but it still knows when to give you room. The timing of the break remains in your hands.  QUIET COMPANY, TOO  For a meeting, screen sharing, or simply a little quiet, you can temporarily hide Knead and bring it back when you are ready.  Knead is not here to manage your day. It just wants to make taking a little break easier—and feel a little more like playing with a cat.

name: Focus Magic & Land of Restoration
lang: Simplified Chinese
short: The magical realm is fading. Wield Focus Magic as a human wizard summoned to restore a withered sanctuary. Play in a cozy side-window while you study or work—let your focus generate Mana to grow magical crops, brew potions, and customize your enchanted home. Your focus is the ultimate magic.
about: About the Game  At its heart, this is a game of mindful companionship and peaceful relaxation. Enter Focus Mode, and your mental energy turns into Mana to nourish the land while you study, work, or simply unwind. During your breaks, plant magical crops, brew potions, fulfill orders, and freely decorate your courtyard and companion cabin. Customize your wizard appearance and follow the main story to uncover the secrets of the world. Team up with companions to save this fading magical realm!  Core Gameplay Features   Windowed Mode & Side-Screen Companion (Picture-in-Picture):   The game doesn't have to take over your screen. Play it in a small window while you use your computer for studying or working. Your courtyard will continuously generate Mana in the background without interrupting your tasks.   Companion Cabin & Pomodoro Timer:   Step into your cozy cabin and start a Pomodoro focus timer. The game window shrinks to the corner of your screen, keeping you company while you work. It even features built-in music and a to-do list. You can invite NPC companions to focus with you—your focus is the most important driving force of the game!   Magical Gardening:   Sow enchanted seeds and care for exotic magical plants. Wait for your crops to mature while you focus. Harvested crops are not only the core ingredients for alchemy but also the materials needed to fulfill orders.   Alchemy Workshop:   Collect plants, Mana crystals, and other materials to brew various potions. Fulfill commissions with your potions to earn rewards. Every successful recipe is automatically recorded in your Alchemy Compendium for easy crafting later.   Familiar System:   Familiars automatically handle chores like sowing and harvesting to reduce your workload. Through alchemy upgrades, they can unlock new abilities like irrigation and resource gathering. Leave the chores to them, so you can focus on yourself!   Orders & Shop System:   Deliver alchemy potions and magical crops to complete orders from villagers, companions, and the Ministry of Magic to earn gold. Spend your gold in the shop to buy brand-new decorations and furniture to beautify yourself and your cabin.   Decoration & Character Customization:   Freely decorate both your outdoor courtyard and your cabin interior. Drag and drop to place items and build your very own magical home. Customize your wizard's appearance anytime to create a unique avatar that represents you.   Main Story & NPC Bonds:   Take on commissions from the Ministry of Magic. Follow the storyline to uncover the hidden secrets of the sanctuary, find the root cause of the magical world's decay, and work towards reviving the land. Complete companion-exclusive quests and spend time with them to deepen your bonds. Every character has a multi-stage, complete personal storyline, unlocking their past, inner conflicts, and exclusive events.  Controls  Mouse: Interact, sow, harvest, and navigate UI.  Cabin Entrance: Toggle the [Focus Companion Mode] anytime. Invite NPCs to focus together.  UI Panels: Click the corresponding icons to open Storage, Alchemy Workshop, Orders, Shop, Compendium, and Multiplayer Panel.  Build / Decorate Mode: Drag and drop buildings, courtyard decorations, and cabin furniture. Click Save to confirm.  Character Panel: Open to access character customization and adjust your wizard's appearance.  Playtime  Main Story: 12–18 hours  100% Completion (Main Story + All Bonds + Compendium + Decoration Collection): 30–40 hours

name: Silklings: A Desktop Pet
lang: English
short: A cozy desktop pet about a pixel spider who lives on your screen. Create your own Silkling, then watch them spin a web in the corner, hunt the bugs that wander by and bring you each catch wrapped like a present. Unwrap them, collect many kinds of bug and record every find in your Book.
about: Silklings puts a teeny spider on your desktop. They put their home in one of your corners and wander along your taskbar getting on with their day whilst you get on with yours.  Make one that's all yours  Pick a body, eyes, markings and colors, then give them a name!          They always land on their feet!  Throw them on the web to make them bounce or the sides of your desktop!            Every bug they catch is a surprise  Bugs rise up from the ground and drift in from the edges of your screen. They hunt them down, wrap them up and hang them in their web for you to unwrap. There are many different kinds of insects to find, each with their own patterns and colors!            Fill the Book  Every new kind you find earns a card. Glue it into the Book and watch the pages fill up, one bug at a time.          There's more..     A burrow under your desktop.  Dig out rooms, light them with lanterns, grow grass and mushrooms, and move in the bugs you've kept.     A personality of his own.  Give them traits from real spiders: they can pounce like a jumping spider or dance like a peacock spider.     A market that changes every day.  A frog sells hats. A chameleon sells bugs or claim silk at the bounty board!     Hats!      And more!     He knows when to make himself scarce  Clicks go straight through them to whatever you're working on. Start a full-screen game and they'll wave, wander off and come back when you're done. And if you ever want a quieter desk, you can switch off the web or their wandering.    Wishlist  Silklings  and we'll let you know when they're ready to move in.

name: Task Bar Isekai
lang: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, French, German, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: Kenta worked himself to death at 3:47 AM… and was reborn under your taskbar. An idle ARPG that fights while you work: loot, forge to +15, beat bosses that break out onto your desktop, and seal your best drops as real Steam items to trade or sell on the Steam Community Market.
about: Your taskbar is an isekai now. Kenta Sato, programmer, stayed at the office until 3:47 AM one time too many. The update froze at 99%… and he was reborn in the  Gekai (下界) , the world beneath your taskbar, where computer glitches are monsters.   Task Bar Isekai  is an idle ARPG that lives in a thin, transparent strip right above your Windows taskbar. Kenta fights on his own while you work, study or browse, and every time you glance down there's something new to grab. Real Steam items. Real Steam Community Market. Found something amazing? Take it to the  Sealing Altar  and turn your best gear into a real item in your  Steam Inventory . Trade it with friends or sell it on the  Steam Community Market .    Epic, Legendary, Mythic and ◆GLITCH◆ gear ,  shiny minions  and  cosmetic skins  can all become Steam items.    Goddess Gifts:  cosmetic drops that Steam hands out for playtime.    Limited weekly seals  keep every item rare and valuable.   Sealed items become  canonical versions : same name and Power, stats that scale to the owner's level, so they're easy to trade.   Changed your mind?  Withdraw  an item from Steam back into the game.   Loot. Forge. Break the seal.    7 rarities , from Common to Mythic and the ultra-rare ◆GLITCH◆ series, with  17 unique powers  like Ctrl+Z, Alt+F4 and sudo.    Forge up to +15  with Protection Ofuda,  fuse 5 duplicates into 1  item of the next rarity, and  reforge  your affixes.    Bosses seal the way (封)  until your gear is strong enough. Slow, satisfying progression with no resets: every upgrade counts.   Made to stay open    Bosses break out of the strip  and onto your desktop. Click them to strike with lightning for 5× damage.   A golden  Wandering Boss  shows up every hour, on the hour.    Watch Chests  fall from the top of your screen, but only while the game is open (folded counts too).    Vigil:  +5% gold, XP and loot for every 30 minutes in a row, up to +100%.    Ponpoko , the tanuki merchant, sets up shop with deals straight out of the Recycle Bin.    Golden critters , combos,  Fever (フィーバー!)  and ultimates with anime cut-ins.   Move your mouse while you work to charge Kenta's  Ki .   Offline progress at 25% (up to 8 hours). The good stuff happens while it's open.   An isekai story with heart (and a terrible boss)  70 story scenes  with portraits: the scatterbrained Desktop Goddess who lives next to your clock, Mika the cache witch, Gonzo the sysadmin monk, Master Neko, Ponpoko… and  Tanaka-bucho , who still wants that report on his desk by 9:00.    4 difficulties × 5 acts × 10 stages , plus the endless  Leviathan's Tower .    3 heroes  with skins, 15 enemies with elites and shinies,  6 bosses , minions, a Camp with 6 buildings, Guild quests, a Goddess Calendar, a Zukan and 66 in-game achievements.   New systems unlock bit by bit, so it never overwhelms you on day one.   Never in your way   Transparent, always on top and docked to your taskbar. Clicks outside the strip go straight to your desktop.   Fold it with one click or from the tray icon. Kenta keeps farming.   Light on your PC: 15/30/60 FPS, toggleable effects and Ghost Mode.

name: Beat Pet
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Danish, Ukrainian, Russian, Japanese, Traditional Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Korean
short: A desktop pet who listens to music with you and plays the drums along to the beat. Most of the time, he quietly keeps you company. But when the music starts, the stage is his.
about: Your Music. His Drum Set. Beat Pet is a desktop pet who listens to whatever you are listening to and plays the drums along with it in real time.  There are no built-in song lists and no special music files to prepare. Play music from your favorite streaming service, a local media player, a video, or even a game. If your computer can play it, your pet can drum along with it.  Every Song Becomes a Performance Your pet reacts to the rhythm and different parts of the music, turning every song into a unique performance. A gentle melody, an energetic rock track, or the song you have played a hundred times: each one gives him a new reason to pick up his drumsticks.  A Companion On and Off the Stage When there is no music, he quietly keeps you company on your desktop. When the music begins, the desktop becomes his stage.  Play anything. He will find the beat.

name: Brawl Burrow Demo
lang: English**
short: Brawl Burrow is a cozy monster-catching game where you care for your Brawlets, build them a home, battle, and catch new ones while the game sits quietly at the bottom of your screen.
about: Brawl Burrow  is a relaxing monster-catching game that runs quietly at the bottom of your screen. Instead of demanding constant attention, it surprises you with small interactions, like feeding your Brawlets, collecting coins, or stepping into battle. With 20 unique Brawlets to catch and care for, your collection will steadily grow as you play. You can also design and decorate your burrow, creating a home that reflects your style. Perfect for players who enjoy light interactions, Brawl Burrow is about collecting, caring, and customizing at your own pace.    Demo compared to full game  In this demo, Brawlets can reach a maximum level of  30  (the full game raises this cap to  100 ). With the lower level cap, you’ll also be unable to access all  80 attacks  found in the complete game.  You can collect  20 unique Brawlets  in the demo, while the full version contains  100 . The full game also expands the building and visual customization systems with more tiles, decorations, backgrounds, weather options, and sun/moon variations.

Enjoying your retirement on this quiet island, all you have to do is keep clicking and harvesting dozens of different crops.   🌱  Basic Tips & Features     Unlocking more tiles gives you access to new crops.    Clicking boosts planting, watering, fertilizing, harvesting, and movement speed.    Increasing your stamina lets you work longer in the field. (Stamina refills when you sleep.) name: SubQuest
lang: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: SubQuest is a productivity game that grows with you, right on your desktop. Cute characters, endless adventures, and a diorama where your heroes rest between quests — decorate it however you like! Notes, to-dos, Time-Quests — get your work done side by side with your hero party!
about: About SubQuest    SubQuest is a productivity game where a party of heroes moves to the rhythm of your input.    Meet your cute hero party, keep notes, to-dos, and a calendar right on your desktop — and head out on an adventure for as long as you choose!    Your party's Time-Quests guarantee a short break after every focused stretch of work, keeping you at your most productive.    1. Pomodoro: Time-Quests    Set out with your party for a set stretch of time! While you focus on your work, your party keeps pace with your input — defeating enemies and growing stronger.    When the adventure ends, collect the spoils. Hard work deserves its rewards!    2. Charming, classic pixel-art RPG design (in a minimal footprint!)    Everything you'd expect from a classic medieval RPG is here! Join a sword-wielding hero, an elf archer with her bow, a slightly clumsy but devastating mage, and a dependable priest.    Grow strong enough to rival the Demon King! Grasslands, coastlines, frozen wastes, lava fields... the journey never ends!    3. Rest after focus! Diorama Mode, with BGM and Lo-Fi music.    N rest themes to unlock    Charming BGM and soothing Lo-Fi tracks to unwind to

name: Sill Sticks - Dress Up Pack
lang: Japanese, English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Indonesian, Ukrainian, Dutch, Greek, Swedish, Spanish - Latin America, Thai, Czech, Danish, Turkish, Norwegian, Hungarian, Finnish, Bulgarian, Vietnamese, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Polish, Malay, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
short: Dress up your desktop stick figure by the mood. Freely mix body color, headwear and speech-bubble background — 6 colors, 7 kinds of headwear, 7 backgrounds — to make your own one-of-a-kind buddy who still mutters away in a corner of your screen.
about: Dress up your stick figure by the mood  With this pack, you can nudge the stick figure that lives on your desktop a little closer to the look you like — body color, headwear, speech-bubble color and more. Make it your kind of stick figure. You can even change the color of its little props.  Three things to choose     Body color  — 6 new colors: red, blue, green, purple, gold and white (7 with the free black).     Headwear  — 7 kinds: top hat, crown, halo, wizard hat, devil horns, nightcap and baseball cap. Since a stick figure can hardly wear clothes, we picked only silhouettes that read clearly on top of the head.     Bubble color  — 7 to choose from: 6 soft pastels plus black.    Mix them freely  Black with a halo, gold with a crown, purple with a wizard hat, and so on. Body and headwear colors are chosen separately, so the combinations are up to you.  What this pack adds    Unlocks everything: 6 body colors, 7 kinds of headwear and 7 speech-bubble backgrounds.    Color × headwear × bubble combinations open up a wide range of looks.    You can even change the color of its little props and the robot.    About settings    You can change or remove the dress-up anytime.    Right-click the icon in the task tray and pick from the “Colors & Dress Up” menu.    Supported languages  This DLC follows the supported languages of the base app, Sill Sticks.   * The base app “Sill Sticks” is required to use this DLC.

name: TaskBar VendingMachine
lang: English, Korean, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
short: A tiny pixel-art vending machine that lives on your Windows taskbar. Customers line up while you work or play. Stock the shelves, set your prices, read the daily news to catch the next trend, and meet quirky regulars, all without leaving your desktop.
about: A vending machine for your taskbar  Task Bar Vending Machine is a cozy idle game that sits right on top of your Windows taskbar. Sell drinks to passing customers while you work or browse the web!              It sells while you work  Customers walk up, think it over for a moment, and buy a drink. The in-game clock follows your real clock, so office workers stop by on their way home and students drop in after school. Just don't forget to keep the machine stocked!              Run your machine  Buy stock for your warehouse, keep an eye on expiry dates, and fill the machine before it sells out. Set a price for every slot, check what sells best in the stats, and spend your earnings on 8 upgrades such as Auto Fill, Checkout speed, and Visit Rate.             Read the news, ride the trends  A daily newspaper tells you what is coming: a heat wave, a fizzy drink challenge sweeping social media, even a sugar tax. Stock up before demand spikes, and steer clear of drinks that are about to cost more.              Make it yours  Switch between 8 machine skins, each with its own small bonus, and change the mood with 8 backgrounds, from a quiet alley to a neon street and a hanok village. You can also go fully transparent and leave just the machine standing on your taskbar.              Meet the regulars  Every customer has their own favorite drinks and their own reasons to stop by. Some only show up at certain hours, during special events, or when you use a certain skin. Fill the codex with everyone from office workers and students to a stray cat, a robot, and a time traveler.

name: Xian Cang
lang: Simplified Chinese
short: This is a pixel-style,ancient-themed desktop idle game that can remember you. Chess secret flip battles, random endgames, window awareness: while you play, the NPCs in the lounge will roast you in all sorts of ways (when intimacy is maxed, more characters unlock), global leaderboard, [local AI chat]
about: ‘Xian Cang’ is a pixel-style, ancient-themed desktop idle management game.   ✦ Idle Management: Customers come and go, dropping coins. Save up to upgrade prosperity; the busier your shop, the more money you make.  ✦ Offline Local AI Dialogue : NPCs will talk to themselves, each with their own unique personality. The game bundles an open-source language model (Qwen2.5) that runs entirely on your player's machine — no internet connection or API key needed.  ✦  Dark Chess Battles : Three difficulty levels AI,  local PvP , matches last just a few minutes.  ✦ Hide and Seek: Detective chases thief, black fog vision, shapeshifting, supports multiplayer.  ✦ Friend Co-building: Invite friends to run the shop together, each contributes to prosperity; they can help fend off sword attacks from invaders.  ✦ 20 Achievements, 3 Global Leaderboards, Creative Workshop map subscriptions.  ✦ Natural Disasters / Hourly Events / Stray Cats / Holiday Easter Eggs... there’s always something new every time you enter. Collect NPCs in the catalog, each has their own story.  The window only takes up a third of your screen – perfect for sneaky work breaks and glancing while idle.

short: Bring a little summer to your everyday desktop. Beach parasols, palm trees, an ice cream cart, a yacht, and more. Each item toggles on or off individually, and line them all up to turn a corner of your screen into a tiny beach resort. Your cats won't obey, but might take a little interest.
about: This is the Summer Pack for Sill Cats. Deck out your desktop with all kinds of summery items. Your cats might take an interest in some of them, too.  What's Included  ・Beach Parasol  ・Palm Tree  ・Watermelon  ・Surfboard  ・Electric Fan  ・Shaved-Ice Stand  ・Ice Cream Cart  ・Yacht  ・Convertible Car    Every item can be turned on or off individually. Just the parasol, just the palm tree, or the whole set? Pick whatever suits your mood that day.  Your cats still won't do as they're told, as always, but they'll show a little curiosity toward these summer trinkets.    How to Use  After buying this DLC, you can place the items on your screen from the Sill Cats settings window.  Open the settings window from the Sill Cats icon in the Windows system tray, or from the cat signboard. If you don't see a cat signboard, open the system tray instead. Check for hidden icons using the "^" button at the bottom-right of your Windows screen.  Please Note    This DLC lets you place summer-themed items on your screen.    The free base app, Sill Cats, is required to use this DLC.

name: Legends of Companion
lang: English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil*
short: Legends of Companion is a strategic auto-battling ARPG roguelite where every choice is yours. Pick from 4 classes, build deep skill trees, forge loot, recruit a battle pet, and chart paths across diverse worlds. Master skills, gear, and team combos to turn one spark into an unstoppable legend.
about: A strategic auto-battling ARPG roguelite where every decision is yours.  You command the build. Pick your champion, choose their skills, forge their  equipment, recruit a battle pet, and chart your path across ever-growing worlds.  The skills you combine, the gear you equip, the team you assemble, and the routes  you take all decide who wins. Turn a single spark into an unstoppable legend,    then come back for the next run, the next class, the next perfect drop.  Every class branches into multiple specializations through its skill tree, so two  players running the same hero can build something completely different. Mix and  match heroes and pets until you find the combination that fits your playstyle.  Bring a Companion Pet  Adopt a battle pet that fights at your hero's side: Wolf, Eagle, Husky,  Rottweiler, Panda, Raccoon, Guinea Pig, rare dragons, and much more. Pets level  up on their own progression track, adding a second source of damage and  personality to every run.  Build Your Power  Skill Trees and Abilities. Spend skill points between waves to unlock and upgrade  nodes, then equip the active abilities that define how you fight. Every class has  a deep, hand-crafted tree with branching specializations at the heart of your  build.  Deep Loot and Equipment. Gear drops constantly. Equip weapons and armor across  every slot, hunt for powerful affixes that boost crit, dodge, lifesteal,  accuracy, and more, and assemble a loadout that turns the tide of battle.  Account-Wide Stash. Stockpile your best finds in a shared stash and carry your  power across every character and every run.  Elemental Combat. Fire, frost, and more react with enemy types, ailments, and  weather. Exploit weaknesses and stack status effects with the right build.  A Run Worth Replaying  Branching Roguelite Maps. Every act is a map of choices: combat, elites, rest,  shops, and surprises, shaped by biome affinities and dynamic weather. Read the  map and forge your own path.  Living Worlds. March through lush meadows, enchanted forests, scorching deserts,  frozen winters, deep caverns, volcanic wastes, the far reaches of space, and the  ocean depths, each with its own atmosphere.

name: Deskdragora Demo
lang: Portuguese - Brazil, Spanish - Latin America, English
short: Deskdragora is a virtual pet game that lives in the corner of your desktop. While you work, study, or browse the internet, your little magical mandragora grows, produces magic, and keeps you company throughout the day.
about: Welcome to the Deskdragora Demo!    In this demo, you will be able to experience the core mechanics of the game, take care of your mandragora, and discover what it feels like to have a magical companion living on your desktop.  Since this is a test version, some progression, customization, and collection systems have been limited, allowing you to experience a preview of the full adventure.    Even so, you can already take care of your magical plant, produce magic, collect items, and discover why so many people are falling in love with this little creature.    If you enjoy the experience, don’t forget to add Deskdragora to your wishlist. The full version will launch on  July 24th, 2026 , featuring all the resources, evolutions, items, and customization options planned for the game.  Your mandragora is waiting for you.

name: My Slimadatchi
lang: English**
short: A cozy desktop companion idle game where you care for your adorable slime as it plays, enjoys treats, and partake in activities with you. Earn slime points to unlock new toys, customize your Slimadatchi shell, and dress up your slime to create a companion that's truly your own!
about: My Slimadatchi is a low-stress desktop virtual pet that lives on your desktop! Place your Slimadatchi device anywhere on your screen, play with your slime, or focus on your work or other games while your slime hops around, plays with toys, enjoys activities, or takes a nap in its own customizable device shell.  Care and Bond With Your Slime  Feed your slime their favorite treats, give them head pats, and spend time together throughout the day! When they're not resting, they'll happily seek out toys to play with and activities to enjoy.          Make Your Slime and Device Your Own!  Use the points your slime earns through playing and hanging out with you to buy treats, toys, clothes, and cosmetics to make their little world your own. Unlock up to 150+ new cosmetics for your slime, and the Slimadatchi shell itself!          Coexisting with Your Slime!  Since slimes don’t share the same biology as us, they are immortal, independent, and happy just to be with you! This makes them the perfect multitasking companion. Place your Slimadatchi device anywhere you like, resize it to your preference, and your slime will always be there while you work, stream, play other games, or simply relax.

Desktop Companion  A small always-on-top window that transforms into a pixel-art burger while the timer is running.     Steam Inventory  Earn collectible ingredients after every completed session and keep growing your kitchen.

name: Tiny Fishing Club Demo
lang: English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Korean*
short: A cozy desktop fishing companion you can leave beside your work. Fish solo or hang out online with friends, catch rare fish, customize your tiny angler, collect pets, and grow your little club.
about: A Cozy Fishing Club With Friends   Tiny Fishing Club  is a cozy online fishing game where tiny characters cast lines, collect fish, customize their looks, and hang out together.  Fish side by side, chat, use emotes, show off rare catches, draw, play music, or simply relax in the same little world with your friends.  Play alone when you want a quiet fishing routine.  Join friends when you want a soft place to talk, collect, and stay awhile.  No pressure. No competition.  Just fishing, friends, and a tiny club to call your own.            A Tiny World on Your Desktop  Tiny Fishing Club is designed to live beside you while you use your PC.  Your character can wander, fish, collect rewards, and keep you company while you work, study, watch videos, or chat. Check in when a fish bites, sell your catch, upgrade your gear, or let your little fishing life continue quietly on your screen.  Focus on it when you want to play.  Leave it open when you want something cozy nearby.            Catch, Collect, Customize  Every catch gives you something small to work toward.  Earn gold, fill your fish collection, unlock gear, expand your bag, collect pets, and customize your character with skins, rods, hats, bags, and more.  Keep favorite fish in your aquarium.  Bring a pet along for the trip.  Dress up, collect rare items, and make your character feel like yours.  Features    Cozy online fishing with friends    Desktop gameplay that stays beside you    Active play or relaxed background progress    Chat, emotes, drawing, music, and catch sharing    Fish collection, aquarium, gold, upgrades, and gear    Character customization with skins, rods, bags, hats, and pets    Cast your line. Invite your friends.  Your tiny fishing club is waiting.

name: Taskbar Garden
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
short: Grow a living procedural garden along your desktop while you work or relax. Harvest plants for profit, breed plants, fuse genetic seeds, and discover rare mutations as every seed grows into a completely unique plant.
about: A tiny garden that lives on your taskbar   Taskbar Garden sits quietly along the bottom of your screen while you work, study, browse or play. Plant a few seeds, get on with your day, and glance down to find fruit, brand-new plants and a little buddy.     Plant. Grow. Pick. Repeat              Plants grow.      Click ripe fruit to collect coins, then buy new seeds, sprinklers, tools and more plots.      Your garden keeps growing while the game is closed.                No two plants are ever the same   Every seed carries its own genes: size, shape, colour, fruit, and sometimes... a face. Two tomatoes will never look quite alike, and every harvest  drops a seed that is  different from its parent.       15 species to discover, from carrots and strawberries to stranger things      6 quality tiers, from Poor all the way up to the rare Special+      Rare colour morphs, variety of faces and shiny plants!                 Fuse seeds into something new   Pick a base and a donor seed, and fuse them into a modifed base seed. Modify the result toward the traits you care about by using fusion items and pass special abilities down. Every fusion is a gamble.           Wild weather, rare mutations   Rain showers, thunder blooms, frostfall, etc... drift across your garden. Plants caught in the weather can mutate. Giving more profits and a chance to pass down mutations to future generation seeds.  [img][/img]         Your slime buddy   A small, round friend lives in your garden. It hops over to ripe plants to cheer them on, naps beside growing ones (which gently speeds them up), and curls up at home when it is tired. It also changes colors based on the seeds it eats and grows traits!  Drag a seed onto it to share a snack. It slowly grows up and changes with what it eats.                Collect them all

name: Manita
lang: English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Arabic*, Simplified Chinese*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Bulgarian*, Danish*, Indonesian*, Dutch*, Finnish*, Traditional Chinese*, Japanese*, Korean*, Spanish - Latin America*, Polish*, Hungarian*, Malay*, Norwegian*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Romanian*, Russian*, Thai*, Turkish*, Ukrainian*, Vietnamese*, Greek*, Czech*, Swedish**
short: Create a personalized AI companion who lives on your desktop and remembers you. Shape Manita’s personality, emotions, appearance and voice, then talk with her by text or voice.
about: CREATE WHO SHE IS    Manita is a customizable AI companion who lives directly on your desktop.   Start by telling her about yourself your name, preferences, likes and dislikes.  Then create the companion you want to meet.  Choose who Manita is, customize how she looks and sounds, and shape the personality behind every conversation.    You don't just choose how Manita looks. You decide who she is.            SHE REMEMBERS YOU   anita remembers you and your previous conversations across sessions.  The information you share gives future conversations context, so every time you return, you're talking to a companion who already knows something about you.              TALK BY TEXT OR VOICE   Start a conversation whenever you want.  Type your messages or speak through your microphone and Manita responds with live AI-generated dialogue powered by Grok. Talk naturally with the companion you created, directly from your desktop.           A COMPANION ON YOUR DESKTOP   Once you've created her, Manita appears directly on your PC desktop.  Click to interact with her, start a conversation, reposition her on your screen or open her menu while continuing to use your computer.  From there, your conversations, Wardrobe, Store, reminders and character settings are always close by.           CUSTOMIZE HER PERSONALITY   Fine-tune the personality you want Manita to have.  Choose from different personality types and archetypes, select emotional tendencies, and adjust traits including:   Empathy • Anger Response • Happiness • Fear • Patience • Self-Confidence   These settings form the foundation of how Manita behaves and responds during conversations.          MAKE HER YOUR OWN   Customize Manita's appearance and voice to create a companion that feels personal to you.  Change her hair, eye color, skin tone, outfits and other cosmetic options, then return to Character Settings whenever you want to adjust her setup.      ALARMS, REMINDERS & COUNTDOWNS   Keep useful everyday tools within reach.  Use Manita's built-in interface to manually create alarms, reminders, countdowns and calendar-style alerts while she stays on your desktop.     GOOD TO KNOW   Manita's live AI conversations are powered by  Grok  and require an internet connection.  The base game includes  10 starting AI tokens . AI conversations consume tokens, and additional tokens can be purchased separately.  Optional randomized cases contain cosmetic customization items only and do not affect Manita's AI capabilities.

name: Astro Mouse
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: "Astro Mouse" is a tabletop game rich in casual idle fun. The quirky little mouse, "Coco," can appear at any time to accompany you as you travel through different planets, explore unknown realms, and use a variety of tools to obtain unique items.

No manual input needed—Coco explores independently, uncovering vintage trinkets and even one-of-a-kind collectibles, each brimming with nostalgia to reveal the untold stories of every planet. name: Guildlands
lang: English, Spanish - Latin America, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Indonesian, Spanish - Spain
short: Forge, fight and trade, together. A multiplayer idle RPG that lives on your taskbar: your hero fights, mines and fishes while you work, and every piece of gear you forge shows on them. Free to play, in a shared world where players set every price.
about: Guildlands is a free multiplayer idle RPG set in Aurelia, a pixel-art world you share with every other player. Send your hero out, close the window and get on with your day: the expedition keeps going, and when you come back the loot is waiting.      Press F9 and the game shrinks into a slim, transparent strip that sits on top of your taskbar. Your hero walks the road, fights and gathers right there, always in view, while you work, study or watch something else. Hover over it to see health, loot and the expedition log. Double-click your hero to jump back into the full game.      In most idle games you equip a sword and nothing changes on screen. In Guildlands every helmet, chest piece, shield and weapon is drawn onto your hero, layer by layer, and dyes change their colors. Choose from 15 classes and 6 races: your class never locks you into a build. Shape it further with spells and war cries, gems set in sockets and a Passive Tree to plan for the long run.           Adventures, missions and dungeons play out while you're away. Every blow comes from your hero's real health, damage and armor: better gear takes you further and brings more back. Five rarities and up to five modifiers per piece mean no two drops are alike.      Mine, chop, fish, hunt and farm in a shared world. Smelt bars, saw planks, cook, brew potions, carve runes and forge your own gear, from a bronze pickaxe all the way to a dragon one. Then build a house of your own and grow it into a workshop, a farm and more.      The best gear in Aurelia is gathered and forged by players, and players set every price, in gold, on the market. There are no fixed shop prices for the good stuff: the market decides. What you don't use, someone else needs.      Found a clan, raise its banner and take on dungeons together. Weekly missions, Honor to earn clan armor, world bosses every day and a single Castle that every clan wants to hold. Clan wars are next.      Aurelia is curated down to the pixel, from the forest wolf to the red dragon. Guildlands is made by a small team together with its community: player ideas are heard, and many of the systems in the game today started as suggestions from players. Features    Your hero lives on your taskbar : press F9 and keep fighting, mining and fishing in a slim strip while you work.    Progress even when closed : expeditions keep running with the game shut, and your loot is waiting when you return.    Gear you can see : every helmet, chest piece, shield and weapon is drawn on your hero, and dyes change its colors.    Players set every price : the best gear is gathered and forged by players and traded for gold on the market.    19 professions, 100 levels each : mine, fish, hunt, farm, cook, brew potions and forge your own gear.    Build it your way : 15 classes, 6 races, spells, runes, socketed gems and a Passive Tree. Your class never locks your build.    Built for clans : a banner, weekly missions, group dungeons, a Castle to hold and a world boss every day.    One shared world : everyone plays together on the same map of Aurelia.    A house of your own : grow it into a workshop, a farm and more, plus mini-pets, achievements and duels.    Free to play, made with its players : many of the game's systems started as player suggestions.   Credits Some of the art in Guildlands was created by  ixz.art  (@ixz.art on Instagram).

name: Desktop Pet: Idle Cats Cozy Chaotic Companions for your screen
lang: English**
short: Adopt cozy cats for your desktop. Watch them nap, wander, climb, chase toys, earn Hearts, and cause tiny chaos while you work or relax.
about: Adopt Adorable Cats That Live on Your Desktop   Desktop Pet: Idle Cats is a cozy desktop companion that keeps you company while you work, study, stream, or relax.  Adopt cats with different personalities, watch them explore your screen, pet and feed them, give them toys, and decorate their tiny desktop home. They may nap peacefully, climb your furniture, chase toys or create a little chaos while you are busy.        Your Cats, Your Desktop Home     Adopt cats from a changing daily selection    Discover different appearances and personalities    Pet, feed, carry, and play with your cats    Collect toys, snacks, furniture, and decorations    Earn Hearts through relaxing interactions    Let your cats play while you focus on other things    No stressful meters, punishments, or constant maintenance        Inspired by our real cats Diesel, Jiji, Momo, Leaw, and Maruay, the game is designed to recreate the cozy, funny, and unpredictable experience of sharing your space with cats.        What to expect?   Unlike traditional virtual pet games, Desktop Pet: Idle Cats is not about constant maintenance or pressure. There are no stressful survival meters, no cleaning chores, and no punishment for stepping away. Instead, the game captures the feeling of having cats nearby while you go about your day. They nap, wander, jump, play, climb, ask for attention, ignore you, and occasionally become tiny agents of chaos.    You begin by adopting cats from a shelter-style daily selection. Each cat comes with its own visual style and personality tendencies. A lazy cat might spend more time sleeping in cozy spots, while a playful cat may chase toys more often. A curious cat may wander and climb, while a shy cat may prefer quieter behavior. These differences help each adopted cat feel like an individual companion rather than a simple skin swap.    Interaction is intentionally light. You can pet cats, pick them up, feed them snacks, place furniture, buy toys, and customize their little desktop environment. Cats can play with balls, puzzle toys, robot toys, and wand toys. They may chase, pounce, nap after playing, or decide they are simply not interested. The design goal is to mimic the charm of real cats: affectionate, unpredictable, funny, and independent.           The game uses Hearts as a cozy currency. Players earn Hearts by spending time with cats, petting them, feeding them, playing with them, and keeping cats at home. Hearts can be spent on adoption slots, furniture, toys, snacks, and future cosmetic items. This creates a gentle progression system without turning the experience into a chore.    Furniture and toys help shape the cats’ environment. Cats can sit on furniture, climb to shelves, sleep in favorite places, chase moving toys, or gather around playful objects. The player can arrange their space, store items, buy new ones, and gradually build a small desktop cat home.    Desktop Pet: Idle Cats is designed for people who want something cute and alive on their screen while working, studying, streaming, or relaxing. It is not a full-screen game demanding constant attention. It is a small companion world that stays nearby, creating little moments of joy throughout the day.    With its soft cat art, idle behavior, daily adoption refresh, cozy customization, and playful chaos, Desktop Pet: Idle Cats aims to be the kind of game that quietly becomes part of your routine.    Further Direction  Our goal is to keep growing the game with new cats, toys, furniture, and cosmetic items. The scope and frequency of future updates will depend on the game's success and the resources available for continued development.    We hope you enjoy Desktop Pet: Idle Cats as much as we enjoyed creating it. We would love to hear your feedback and suggestions

name: Sia Desktop Pet
lang: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: A chibi VTuber who lives on your desktop, on top of everything you do. Pet her and feed her, and she opens up one thing at a time: monster battles, tarot readings, 11 outfits and 40 achievements. Soccer, fishing and three more play modes arrive one a week in updates.
about: She lives on your desktop, not in a window Sia sits on top of everything you do. She walks the edge of your screen, naps while you work, reacts when you drag her, and pipes up when you have been at it too long. No launcher to open, no window to keep in focus — she is just there.         She opens up slowly You start with petting and feeding. Bonding raises her affinity level, and each level hands you something new — a shop item, a play mode, a reason to come back. Nothing is unlocked on day one.             Battles  — clear stages, meet bosses, spend the gems you earn    Tarot  — a daily draw with a reading in her own voice    Weather briefing  — she tells you what today looks like outside    Calendar  — write down a plan and she reminds you at the time; repeats and places too    Picture diary  — she writes about what the two of you did, and pastes in a photo of the day    Studio  — upgrade her broadcast setup, tier by tier    Wardrobe  — 11 outfits, some seasonal and only buyable in season    One a week, in updates  — soccer, baseball, basketball, jumping, fishing (a 24-species dex) and finally a desktop aquarium open one by one after launch                  40 achievements that ask for real play Not a checklist you finish in an afternoon. Reaching affinity Lv.15, collecting every outfit, maxing the studio, filling the picture diary — these are the long ones. Steam Cloud keeps your save across machines. Eight languages Korean, English, Japanese, Simplified and Traditional Chinese, Russian, Spanish, Portuguese. Every one of Sia's lines is translated, not just the menus. There is no voice acting — she talks in text. Yandere mode — read this before you buy it An optional mode you unlock in the shop, with each ability bought and toggled separately. When it is on, Sia gets possessive: she throws knives, cracks your screen, and  shows fake system notifications and error windows . The fake alerts and error windows are drawings Sia paints, not real system dialogs. The window and cursor abilities, though, are real — she will shove your open windows aside and cage your cursor for a few seconds. She never touches your files or settings, every ability is bought and toggled separately, and the screen-filling effects have their own switch in Settings. If that kind of joke is not for you, leave the mode locked. The game plays fine without it.         What she reads from the internet The weather briefing needs to know roughly where you are. It looks that up from your IP address and asks a public weather service — no account, no login, no personal data stored on our side. Turn the briefing off and she stops asking.

name: Pocket Adventurer Demo
lang: English
short: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives at the bottom of your own screen. Delve dungeons, collect companions, and retire legends while you work. No servers, no season pass, yours forever.
about: A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar.  Pocket Adventurer sets up camp at the bottom of your screen — a tiny, always-on-top strip that shares your desktop instead of taking it over. Click into camp to check in, or leave it running while you work, study, or do literally anything else. Your hero trains, delves, and loots on their own.  Send your hero into the dungeon. Auto-combat runs through hand-designed dungeons, each with its own monster families, environments, and a boss at the end. Loot piles up, your hero levels, and the deeper you go, the stranger the world gets.      Build a camp, not just a character. Recruit companions who join your hero in camp and in the dungeon. Train at the Training Ground and grow a small roster of heroes over time — not just one build, a whole cast.      Retire your heroes into legend. When a hero's run is done, retire them into the Hall of Heroes, where their statue keeps giving back — a small passive buff that grows as their statue's tier rises. Every hero you've ever run becomes part of what makes the next one stronger.  No servers. No season pass. No login. Yours forever. Pocket Adventurer is a single-player game that lives on your machine — nothing to log into, nothing that stops working if a server goes dark, nothing designed to pressure you back in. Play it for five minutes between meetings or leave it running all day; it's built to survive both.  A cozy idle RPG for your desktop.

name: Desktop Rave: Idle Audio Club
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Malay
short: Desktop Rave is a rhythm/idle/incremental desktop companion that turns the music you play on Windows into game resources! Like Bongo cat but with each beat of your music playing on Windows!
about: 🎧 You are the DJ of your own club! They dance to whatever music you're playing and earn resources with each beat.  🎵 Support any music player/browser on Windows, Apple Music/Spotify/Chrome/Firefox anything goes.  🤖 All the art assets were hand made by human, 0% AI assets involved.                   ✨ Key Features:      Idle/Incremental Gameplay:  The club generates resource with each beat that can be used to upgrade and expand.     Free Placement:  You can scale/move/rotate the game view and place wherever suit you the best on the Desktop.     Full Customization:  You can build and customize the lighting/layout/shape of your own unique club.                     💻 Built for the Background  Very low performance overhead when running in the background  🎛️  Light sensitivity options:  All lighting effects can be dimmed, and flashing effects can be slowed down.  🤓 Linux Support:  With GE-Proton11-9 and launch option set to:"WINE_LAYERED_OVERLAY_ALPHA=1 %command%", shut-out to the community member who discovered it❤️     Q&A:    Does the game record my audio or send it to a server for processing?  No. This is a single player game that runs without a server or internet connection. All audio data is processed locally in real time and discarded immediately.     Does the game know what I’m listening to?  The game only analyzes audio frequencies and amplitudes, for example: an amplitude of 0.7 in the 50–250 Hz frequency band.     Does the game work with any music player or browser?  Yes. The game listens to your Windows audio output, so you can use any music player or browser. Apple Music, Spotify, SoundCloud, and YouTube all work, including playback through browsers such as Chrome and Firefox.     Does the game work with any music genre? What about slow music?  Yes. The game works with any music genre. Certain perks in the skill tree compensate for slower music.     Privacy (Steam Windows)   This game may read your Steam country code once at boot to choose consent rules. That code is not saved and is not sent to a developer server. If Steam country is unavailable, the game treats location as unknown and asks before optional statistics.  If allowed by regional policy or your consent, the game may send optional gameplay analytics to GameAnalytics (build/version, an anonymous save-slot id that is never reused after deletion, playtime on that save, and economy, tutorial, building, and Club Promo actions). It does not send Steam account ids, save names, song titles, or grid positions. It may also write coarse lifetime totals through Steam UserStats, linked to your Steam account. Analytics are not required to play, are not sold, and are not used for ads. Unity Analytics and Unity Ads are disabled.  You can allow or deny this at the boot prompt (protected/unknown regions) and later in Settings → Privacy. Turning it off stops future sends. The game cannot delete data GameAnalytics or Steam already hold. Use this page’s support email for privacy questions.  Unity Diagnostics separately sends crash and exception reports, device and software details, session information, and an installation ID to Unity to investigate errors and improve stability. This reporting can start before your analytics consent choice and continues if you decline analytics or the age affirmation, or turn off Gameplay analytics in Settings → Privacy. There is no in-game opt-out for Diagnostics. Unity documents a default 90-day retention period for Diagnostics personal data. Use this page’s support email for privacy questions or access/deletion requests. Requests for a specific installation require its Unity installation ID.  Club saves and slot previews can sync through Steam Cloud (download on launch, upload on exit). Dynamic Cloud Sync is not used. Device preferences (audio, graphics, privacy, etc.) stay on this PC and do not sync. The game is not directed at children under 13.

short: An idle fishing game that lives on your desktop, right on top of your taskbar. Your chosen angler casts all day while you work or play. Click a bite for a better catch, fill your aquarium with your best fish, and keep watch for Patchy, the legendary fish nobody has ever caught.
about: An endless fishing journey that sits on your taskbar  Patchy: The Legendary Fish is a cozy idle fishing game that lives along the bottom of your screen. A little lakeside diorama sits right on top of your taskbar, and your angler fishes in it all day while you work, browse or watch videos. Clicks pass straight through to your desktop, so it never gets in your way.  Automated Fishing    Your angler casts, waits and reels in on their own.    When a bite alert comes up, click it fast for a chance at a better fish.     Your angler keeps fishing while the game is closed, and your catches are waiting when you come back.           Real weather, in real time  The lake follows your computer's clock, from dawn to night. Type in your city and the weather matches yours too. Rain, storms, and fog each bring different fish to the surface, and some only bite at certain times of the day.  Catch and collect    14 freshwater fish to find, from Fathead Minnows to the Lake Sturgeon, plus junk and lost treasure.    Your best catches swim in PawPaw's tank . It holds up to 50 fish, three of each kind, ranked by size.    Feed your fish every so often and watch them come up and eat just like real fish.           Hunt the legend  Every glimpse of Patchy's shadow and every snapped line goes in PawPaw's Journal, and each one raises your odds of finally catching him.  PawPaw's Journal  PawPaw Steven spent his whole life chasing Patchy: the biggest fish ever! Patchy is scarred and patched like an old coat, with a hundred rusty hooks hanging from his lip. Everybody around Steven's Lake has heard the legend but nobody has ever caught him, is Patchy even real? Now PawPaw's chair, rod, tank and journal are yours.       PawPaw's grandkids  Pick one of six grandkids, each with their own strengths, weaknesses and trait, across Normal, Hard and Nightmare difficulties. Switch between them at any time.         Upgrade your tackle  Spend your coins on a better Rod, Line, Bait and Chair, each up to level 10.  Made for your desktop    Steps aside automatically when a fullscreen game or video is in front.    Live weather, sound and display options, plus a tray icon to pause or hide.    Plenty of Steam achievements to earn while you play.

name: How To Goblin

about: HOW TO GOBLIN   One tiny goblin. One dungeon platform. Endless crafting.   Meet your new desktop companion! In  How To Goblin , a hardworking little goblin spends his days forging weapons on a small dungeon platform – right on your desktop.  Let him work while you browse the internet, study, or play other games. Check in whenever you like, collect his creations, and help him expand his little forge.  FORGE, CRAFT & COLLECT  Your goblin automatically crafts items at his workstation. Every creation has a chance to be something special!  Discover common treasures, uncommon equipment, rare weapons, and legendary finds. Fill your collection book and see how many unique items you can discover.          FILL YOUR BACKPACK  Every crafted item goes straight into your backpack. Watch your loot pile up, then sell your collection for shiny gold coins.  But keep an eye on your storage space! Once your backpack is full, your goblin takes a break until you make room for more.          UPGRADE YOUR FORGE  Invest your hard-earned gold in upgrades and help your goblin become a better blacksmith.     Hammer Speed  – Craft items faster.     Coin Value  – Earn more gold from crafting.     Stamina  – Work longer before needing a break.     Recovery  – Reduce your goblin's resting time.    Every upgrade brings you closer to the next stage of your forge. Watch your simple workstation gradually transform into an improved blacksmithing setup.          COMPLETE YOUR COLLECTION  Discover unique weapons and treasures across different rarity levels. Every new discovery is permanently recorded in your collection book – even after you sell the item.  Can you discover them all?          YOUR COZY DESKTOP COMPANION  How To Goblin lives in a small, transparent window directly on your desktop. Move him wherever you like, resize his dungeon platform, and let him keep forging while you focus on other things.  No rush. No stress. Just a tiny goblin doing his best.   Complete your collection, upgrade your forge, and give your little goblin a place on your desktop!

about: Desktop Idler Game 1: Farming   is an idle farming game that sits at the bottom of your screen  while you do other things. Plant seeds and a little robot takes care of your tiny farm.        Grow crops:  Click a plot, pick an action, and the robot walks over to do it. Plant seeds,  water dry soil, harvest ripe crops. Whatever the bot harvests, it replants on its own.        Discover new crops:  You start with carrots. Reach the harvest milestones to unlock chili, corn,  onion, tomato, and garlic. Each crop grows at its own pace and sells for a different price.        Level up:  Every harvest earns experience. Leveling expands your field from 10 plots up to 20, and     tiny helper bots join the crew at higher levels to share the work.        Built for multitasking:  A thin strip you can slide anywhere between the top and  bottom of your screen, on whichever monitor you like. Click the bubble and they're happy.  • Sometimes they peek up from the bottom of your screen, paws on the edge, and giggle when you catch them. They push little balls off the desk one nudge at a time, and if your cursor sits still, a kitten crouches, wiggles its butt and pounces.         • Cats use real kitten sounds: a soft "mew~" when they want attention, sniffles when they're sad, purrs when you pet them. Every pet has its own little voice, kept quiet so it never gets in the way.  • Every pet has its own personality: clingy, aloof, dramatic, sweetheart, curious, sleepy, foodie... A clingy one comes looking for you after a minute. An aloof one takes its time.  • They remember the little things: what you fed them, how you played, the times you comforted them. Every new species lights up a new spot in your collection book.  • Duplicates are never wasted: the more of one species you collect, the bigger its earning bonus, and duplicate furniture levels up on its own.  • The 16 mixed breeds never come from eggs. The only way to get them is to let your pets fall in love. Your collection book hints at which two species can have one, and the same couple is guaranteed one by their third baby.  • There are also 34 pieces of kitchen gear, 6 signature dishes and 111 achievement stickers to complete.    💗 Clingy, and they care about you  • Still up after midnight? They'll tell you to go to bed. They say good morning when you boot up and remind you to eat at mealtimes.  • When you're typing like crazy, one trots over: "You're working so hard. Take a little break?"         • As they grow fond of you, they'll say "I love you", thank you for looking after them and ask what gift you'd like. Their love for you never fades.  • They secretly dig up treasure for you every day and come running with a gift box: "This is for you!" Gifts come in five rarities, from Common to a shimmering gold Legendary. The more a pet adores you, the better the box, with coins, gems, snacks, extra pet slots and kitchen gear inside.    💞 Falling in love, having babies, picking names  • A boy and a girl who spend time together slowly fall in love. They cuddle on the love bench and play on the seesaw. Once their bond is full, they may have a fluffy little baby.  • When a baby is born, a bubble pops up over mom's head asking you to name the baby yourself, with suggestions that blend mom's and dad's names.  • Newborns are tiny milk babies. name: Taskbar Parade
lang: English, Japanese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
short: A desktop companion game: a tiny parade of cute animals walks along the top of your taskbar while you work. Pet them, catch sparkles on the road, grant their daily wishes, send them exploring, and collect hats, friends and souvenirs. Quiet by default — it never gets in the way.
about: Your taskbar has a parade now.  Taskbar Parade is a desktop companion that keeps you company while you do other things. A little duck captain leads a line of friends — hamsters, frogs, penguins, capybaras, a dinosaur — marching just above your taskbar while you work, study or stream. They waddle, stop for a sit, peck at crumbs when you type, and curl up for a nap when you step away.  Quiet by default  The parade stays small and calm: no numbers, no pop-ups over your work. It hides itself when a full-screen app is open. Want more action? Switch to Lively mode and watch them bonk grumpy crows and picnic geese with a scrolling backdrop.  A little something every day     Daily wishes  – each day three friends ask for something small ("pet us 5 times", "walk 2 km together"). Grant them for acorns and keep your streak going. Missing a single day is forgiven.     Sparkles  – every now and then something glints on the road. Click it before it's gone.     Pet your friends  – click any of them for a squish and a heart.    Things to collect     Friends  in three coats — normal, gold and galaxy.     40 hats  in six themes. Wear three or five of one theme for a set bonus and a parade title ("Seaside Parade").     30 souvenirs  from six places, brought home from expeditions.     Postcards  of every new place your parade reaches, and a travel diary that writes itself.     Flags  for your captain to carry, and 46 achievements.    Friends who grow with you  Bond grows with the time you spend together — through walks, pets, treats and wishes. After the last bond level, friends earn bond stars forever.  Expeditions  Send a friend off to the beach or the snowfield for 1, 4 or 8 hours. They come back with acorns, souvenirs, sometimes a charm — and closer to you.  Trade with other players  Hats and friends are Steam items. Trade them, list them on the Steam Community Market, or trade up ten spares for one rarer item. Crates arrive from Steam as you play (every 30 minutes, up to 10 a day). No paid loot boxes.  Made for streamers  Streamer mode shows only the parade, so you can put it under your stream with OBS game capture.  About input counting  With the optional "crumbs from typing" setting, the game counts how many times you press a key or click — only the count, never which key. Nothing is saved or sent. You can turn it off in Settings.

lang: English, Korean, French, German, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
short: Hatch eggs in a thin strip above your taskbar while you work. Fuse any two Hatchlings into a new species, then hand them to your adventurers as weapons. An idle RPG with 47 creatures to discover. Never steals focus, clicks pass through. One price, no ads. Free demo out now.
about: A tiny village, right above your taskbar.    Hatchbar is a small idle game that lives in a thin strip along the bottom of your screen. While you write, code or watch something, a pixel village goes about its day down there: adventurers hunt, eggs hatch, and Hatchlings, the tiny monsters you raise, grow up. It never takes keyboard focus, and clicks on its empty parts go straight through to your work.    The village keeps a journal  The village journal tells its story one entry at a time as you play. Guests bring rumors, and the field guide leaves riddles in the boxes you have not filled yet.    Poke the village  You do not need to open a menu. Click a building to go straight to it, tap a warm egg to hatch it, pet a Hatchling and it talks back. Some of them get annoyed if you keep going.    Requests and a focus candle  The village board always has a few small requests to work toward. Light a 25- or 50-minute focus candle while you work; when it burns down, an egg is waiting.    Your Hatchlings become their weapons  There are no classes. Hand an adventurer a Hatchling, and when they set out from the village it bursts into sparks and comes back together in their hands as a weapon. Every species turns into a different one and brings its skill along. When they come back to the village, it hops back down and follows them around.    The weapon grows with you  A Hatchling in the weapon slot earns experience from every hunt. Enhance it all the way to +15: at +5 and +10 the weapon takes on a new look, and its skill hits harder and looks bigger. From +6, each step also takes shards of that Hatchling's own species. Enhancement never fails.    Armor and trinkets come from the hunt  Bosses always leave something behind, and ordinary hunts sometimes do. Armor keeps your adventurers standing. Trinkets push critical hits, speed and how much the village brings home. Compare, lock, or break down what you do not need.    Mix two into one you have never seen  Pick any two Hatchlings and they become something new, usually one tier higher. Tier 4 needs two of one element, though, and tier 5 only comes from certain pairs. The pair always decides the species, so every discovery is real knowledge. Only its quality is rolled: plain, good, great or rare, with the odds shown on the fusion card before you mix, and if 19 fusions go by without a rare, the 20th is rare. Nothing is ever lost or downgraded. Pairs you have never tried show only ???.    Grow, branch, and dead-end on purpose  Hatchlings gain experience in battle and glow when they are ready to evolve. Some lines branch. Some end. Then there is the altar: offer two to six Hatchlings and see how it answers. Cold, warm, hot. The right offering wakes something that is not on any chart.    Rebirth and carry one friend  Clear enough hunting grounds and you can start the village over with one Hatchling of your choice. Every rebirth opens something new.    Built to be ignored  Close the game and your village keeps going at half pace for up to 12 hours at first, and up to 24 and then 48 hours as you rebirth. Clicks pass through the empty parts of the strip. Leave your PC alone for a while and the adventurers pitch camp by the fire and keep hunting on their own, using almost no CPU. When you come back, one line tells you what they brought home.    What you get     47 species across six star tiers, including hidden ones you will only find by trying     Every Hatchling becomes a weapon in battle, enhanced up to +15, with a new look at +5 and +10     Armor and trinkets with their own stats, dropped by bosses and hunts     An equipment window and inventory to compare and break down gear     Six personalities with their own lines     A guest who visits once a day, no streaks to keep     46 Steam Achievements, a weekly boss leaderboard, Steam Cloud saves     Mornings, evenings and nights that follow your PC clock, and a winter village every December     A focus candle that turns finished sessions into eggs     Ru

name: Task Bar Dungeons
